postings.title: (Senior) RF Engineer mmW Innovation (f/m/d)
postings.description:
For many applications, there is an ongoing need to make use of higher frequencies of the electromagnetic spectrum, which require technological innovations both for development and validation of new products. Therefore, NXP Germany is engaging in the German part of the EU R&D program “important project of common European interest” (IPCEI) for microelectronics.

As part of this program, NXP has built a brand-new facility for high frequency technologies in Hamburg: the “Terahertz Lab” serves as a system-level RF competence center supporting product development and innovation projects for multiple products lines. Further, new concepts for system-level RF validation are investigated in the sub-THz spectrum and beyond (frequency range ≥ 100 GHz). The Terahertz Lab will be a key player supporting innovation and development for the next generation of automotive radar, robotics, and connectivity solutions within NXP.

Your Responsibilities

- Contribute to product development and innovation projects, including concept development, feasibility studies, prototyping, simulation, and validation in the context of future RF technologies.
- Conceptualize, design and implement automated RF and communications test solutions with software-controlled environments.
- Develop test specifications, test plans, and test instructions for efficient and performant test solutions.
- Analyze & troubleshoot test problems (SW, HW, measurement equipment).
- Plan and coordinate test and validation jobs according to specifications.
- Continuous improvement of lab processes, methods, and lab automation.
- Analyze and post-process measurement and simulation data, create reports and presentations.
- Perform system-level RF simulations and electro-magnetic full-wave simulations.
- Characterization and behavioral modeling of RF components and devices.
- Design, prototype, and build RF demonstrators for mmWave and sub-THz applications.
- Collaborate with internationally distributed internal and external partners (suppliers, universities, etc.).
- Mentor working students and support knowledge transfer.
- Ensure compliance with ISO9001/IATF16949 standards in documentation and procedures.

Your Profile

- Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, Physics, or a comparable field.
- Minimum 3 years of experience in RF engineering.
- Deep understanding of test methods and measurement techniques for RF, communications, and/or radar.
- Practical experience in software and hardware debugging and troubleshooting.
- Proficient in RF/mmWave system-level simulation tools, like Keysight SystemVue and experience with full-wave EM simulation tools, like HFSS.
- Hands-on experience with programming languages, like Python, MATLAB.
- Basic knowledge of statistical methods and data analysis.
- Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, combined with solid project management capabilities and a solution-oriented mindset.
- Excellent analytical thinking, with a structured, quality-oriented, and well-organized work style.
- Fluent in German and English (spoken and written).
- Willing to travel internationally (~2-8 weeks/year).

Please note: The successful candidate may/will be responsible for security related tasks. The assignment may/will be in scope of security certifications, therefore a conscious and reliable way of working is necessary.

postings.legal_entity: AT61 NXP Semiconductors Austria GmbH & Co KG
postings.description:
Shape the Security Behind Millions of Connected Devices

How do you protect an ePassport, payment chip, secure element, connected vehicle, or IoT device against sophisticated attackers?

At NXP's Competence Center Crypto & Security, you'll join a global team of security architects, cryptographers, and embedded security experts who help build secure, trusted, and certifiable products used worldwide.

We're looking for an experienced Product Security Architect with a passion for embedded security, secure software design, and solving complex security challenges.

What You'll Do

- Define, review, and improve security architectures for embedded software, firmware, operating systems, and secure platforms.
- Perform threat modeling, risk assessments, and attack surface analysis.
- Investigate security vulnerabilities, identify root causes, and define countermeasures.
- Support security-by-design throughout the product lifecycle.
- Collaborate with customers, development teams, certification bodies, and security evaluation labs.
- Contribute to innovative security solutions for next-generation connected products.

What You'll Bring

- Master's or PhD in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong embedded software development experience in C/C++.
- Solid background in embedded security and secure system design.
- Experience with security architecture, threat analysis, or vulnerability assessments.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Ideally, You Also Have Experience With

- Smart Cards, Secure Elements, Java Card, or Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs)
- Common Criteria (CC), EMVCo, SESIP, or similar certification schemes
- Cryptography, Secure Boot, Key Management, HSMs, or Firmware Protection
- Secure Coding, Threat Modeling, and Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) practices

Why Join NXP?

Your work will help secure technologies used in:

- Digital Identity & ePassports
- Payment & Secure Elements
- Automotive & Industrial Systems
- IoT & Connected Edge Devices
- Next-Generation Secure Platforms

Think like an attacker. Build trust by design. Shape the future of secure embedded systems.

For applications in Gratkorn: NXP provides market competitive compensation according to the benchmarking of the electronic and semiconductor industry. Due to the Austrian Equal Treatment Act we are obligated to state the employment group of our applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) “Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte Gewerbe und Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung“, this position (fulltime) is graded in Employment Group V after 6 years. Job Title: Agentic Security Engineer

Job Position: Agentic Security Engineer

Role Summary

The Agentic Security Engineer at NXP Semiconductors is responsible for securing agentic AI systems, autonomous workflows, AI orchestration frameworks, and AI-driven tool execution environments across enterprise and engineering domains. This role emphasizes the security of runtime execution, agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, tool invocation mechanisms, and autonomous decision-making processes.

The Agentic Security Engineer will work closely with AI engineering, platform engineering, enterprise security, and architecture teams to help ensure agentic systems are deployed securely and in alignment with NXP security standards, runtime control requirements, and applicable regulatory expectations.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience in runtime security, AI orchestration technologies, API security, policy enforcement, and distributed systems security, along with a strong understanding of risks such as prompt injection, unsafe tool execution, unauthorized actions, context manipulation, memory poisoning, and insecure agent behavior.

This position will support the design and implementation of runtime security controls, AI agent monitoring, action validation mechanisms, execution tracing, and scalable guardrails for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems.

Your Opportunity

NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.

Job Responsibility

1.Agentic Security Architecture and Runtime Controls

- Translate security requirements and operational risks into runtime enforcement and execution control mechanisms
- Contribute to secure adoption of agentic AI capabilities aligned with enterprise security and governance requirements
- Support security architecture discussions for AI orchestration platforms and autonomous systems
- Perform security assessments of agentic AI systems, orchestration frameworks, and enterprise integrations
- Review integrations involving MCP servers, APIs, plugins, external tools, and enterprise platforms

2.AI Runtime Monitoring and Operational Security

As an AI/ML driven ASIC Design and Implementation Automation Engineer in our Advanced Chip Engineering (ACE) organization, you will work in a dynamic environment to explore methodology, flows and tools to improve efficiency and quality of results (power, performance, area, and quality) for SoC and IP development teams across the organization. You'll be working and connecting with AI/ML and automation experts in the industry as well as academia to explore state-of-the-art AI/ML CAD techniques as a part of VLSI CAD SW, prescribe key methods and requirements for tools & features to leverage for ASIC design.

In this role, you will develop prototype solutions to evaluate various state-of-the-art AI/ML techniques to identify the best solutions for NXP designs. While exploring these new ways of working, successful candidates will be working on actual designs and implementation to pilot and develop the automation.

This opportunity is within ACE 'Design Methodologies and Automation' organization to enable transformation to leverage state-of-the-art AI/ML ideas to improve NXP designs for the Automotive Processors and Advanced microcontrollers in NXP.
The right candidate will be working in a fast-paced engineering environment, on a leading-edge advanced node technologies enabling automated building of exciting and complex SoCs.

Job Summary:

- Explore research ideas and solutions that bring AI/ML applications to VLSI design

- Work closely with Academic research communities in AI/ML for VLSI design, Architecture teams, IP and SoC designers and SoC Implementation teams from multiple sites to explore and evaluate for leading edge SoC technologies serving multiple industries

- These automation applications include use of GenAI, Reinforcement Learning, Graph Neural Networks, and convolutional Networks

- Strong AI/ML expertise, software and CAD background required

Cross functional aspects:

- In this role, the candidate will work with multiple NXP Engineering teams, including Architecture, IP & SoC design, verification and implementation functions, coordinate and drive groundbreaking initiatives for Digital Transformation.

Qualifications:

- BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related disciplines with strong background in SW development

- Hands-on expertise in programming using Python/C++

- 5+ years of experience in AI and ML techniques (LLMs, CNN, RNN, and GraphNN) with experience of application to real world optimization problems

- Data structures, algorithms, and SW development for optimization problems

- Hands on experience in Unix/Linux, revision control (Git, BitBucket), SW development and debug tools

- Excellent analytical problem-solving skills

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Desirable skills/experience:

- Strong understanding of design, layout, constraints (SDC, Clocks, CDC, RDC), Static timing analysis, Low-power, and Power-aware flows (UPF)

- Prior experience in VLSI CAD methodology and tool development

- Good understanding of HDL: System Verilog, Verilog, VHDL, front-end design, physical design and layout implementation/generation flows and tools

- Understanding or prior experience with EDA tools for design, verification, DFT and implementation

- Experience with Design revision control (GIT, DesignSync) and Make

- Splunk, Jenkins, LSF and CI/CD process

Job location:

- San Diego, CA

The base salary range for this position is as mentioned below per year. We also provide competitive benefits, incentive compensation, and/or equity for certain roles.
Company benefits include health. dental, and vision insurance. 401(k), and paid leave. Please note that the base salary range (OR hourly rate) is a guideline, and individual total compensation may vary based on a number of factors such as qualifications, skill level, work location, and other business and organizational needs. This base pay range is specific to California and is not applicable to other locations. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range as of the date of this posting is:
$125,000 to $171,900 annually

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on AI/ML leader to lead our AI Systems team in Hamburg, working closely with Product Management, System Architects, and engineering teams to define and enable AI/ML solutions for NXP's next-generation edge products and platforms.

The successful candidate will lead a local team of AI/ML architects and engineers, driving technical excellence and execution across AI system architecture, evaluation, and prototyping activities. As part of the global AI Systems organization, this role will collaborate closely with the AIS AI Systems Lead and peer teams across various locations to develop scalable AI solutions and accelerate Edge AI innovation across NXP's portfolio.

Lead the Hamburg AI Systems team and actively contribute to technical activities, including:

- Supporting Product Management in evaluating and defining AI/ML architectures for target products and solutions, balancing customer requirements, performance, power, area, and cost constraints.
- Working closely with SoC, system, and software architects to develop, review, and maintain AI/ML architecture specifications, requirements, and related technical documentation.

Ready to join the future of innovation?

NXP Automotive Radar product line is expanding its leadership position and providing ground-breaking and innovative products & solutions to the Automotive Market. Significant technical challenges must be overcome to make these products a reality and this journey will provide a truly rewarding experience.

We are looking for an AMS, RF&mmWave TEST ENGINEER. In this exciting role, you will be part of a team in charge of the development of Industrial Test Solutions for Mass production.

Your Responsibilities:

You will be developing industrial test solutions (hardware and software) for mass production and support the design team during the development phase of new products. You will be accountable for driving your deliverables to timely completion with the high quality expected by our customers.

Balancing electrical performance, time-to-market, quality, and cost is the daily challenge you embrace. You will be involved from the very beginning of the specification and design of the product. Based on your inputs, Design for Test features will be implemented to make sure we can achieve the expected performances and quality levels at the lowest cost. As the project progresses, you will develop the test strategy and associated test programs and ATE hardware. In close cooperation with all functions in the team, you will prepare your test setup for the formal product qualification and release into mass production.

You have excellent communication skills and proven ability to collaborate across organizational and geographical boundaries. You used to make timely decisions in face of incomplete information, managing risks and setting priorities driven by business impact. You have the passion for innovation, the desire to challenge yourself and want to put your creativity in enabling our profitable growth by providing state-of-the-art industrial test solutions for our new products.

Your profile:

- More than 10 years of Analog, RF/mmW test development experience using ATE-systems (Advantest & Smartest8 experience is a plus)
- Experience in Analog, RF/mmW PCB design for developing ATE loadboard as well as contacting technology selection.
- knowledge in Analog, RF/ mmW measurement techniques, design for testability, (Digital & High-speed digital experience is a plus)
- Familiar with quality screening techniques
- Fluency in English language both oral and written and skills to operate in a global environment with multiple partners in US, Europe and Asia

postings.title: Analog Mixed Signal Circuit Design
postings.description:
Job Title: Principal/Sr Principal Circuit Designer – Analog / SERDES (Automotive Transceivers)

Location: This position is located in San Jose, CA. This is a hybrid role with 3 days in office and 2 days work from home. This role is NOT open to 100% remote.

Role Summary:

Seeking a Principal or Senior Principal Circuit Designer to design and deliver high‑speed, high‑linearity analog and SERDES circuit blocks that form the Analog Front End (AFE) of automotive transceivers.

This is a hands‑on individual contributor role requiring deep expertise in TX, RX, and clocking circuit design for high‑speed PHYs. The role focuses on block‑level ownership, from specification and transistor‑level design through silicon validation and production support. At the Senior Principal level, the role also provides technical leadership across projects, influencing architecture and mentoring other designers.

Job Responsibility:

Analog / SERDES Circuit Design

· Architect, design, and simulate analog circuit blocks that comprise the AFE, including:

o Transmit (TX) circuits: line drivers, pre‑drivers, output stages

o Receive (RX) circuits: front‑end amplifiers, CTLE, PGA, slicers

o Clocking circuits: PLLs, DLLs, clock distribution, jitter filtering

· Translate system‑ and PHY‑level requirements into robust block‑level specifications.

· Optimize designs for linearity, noise, jitter, power, area, and robustness.

· Perform detailed transistor‑level simulations across PVT corners and full automotive temperature ranges.

Silicon Bring‑Up, Debug & Production Support

· Support silicon bring‑up, characterization, and validation of analog/SERDES blocks.

· Correlate simulation results with silicon measurements and drive design improvements.

· Collaborate with layout, digital, DSP, systems, test, and product engineering teams.

· Drive resolution of performance, yield, and reliability issues through root‑cause analysis.

Technical Leadership (Principal / Sr Principal Scope)

· Serve as block‑level technical owner for critical analog/SERDES functions.

· Participate in and lead technical design reviews.

· Influence AFE and PHY architecture decisions through deep technical expertise.

· Mentor senior and mid‑level designers and contribute to design best practices.

Job Qualification:

Education

· MSEE or PhD in Electrical Engineering or equivalent (strongly preferred).

Experience

· 12–15+ years of experience in analog or mixed‑signal IC design (Principal).

· 15–20+ years of experience for Senior Principal level.

· Proven hands‑on experience designing high‑speed SERDES or wireline analog circuits.

· Demonstrated success delivering TX, RX, and clocking circuits to production silicon.

· Extensive experience with circuit design, simulation, and debug at the transistor level.

Examples of Core Technical Expertise

· High‑speed TX and RX circuit design

· Linearity, distortion, and noise analysis

· Jitter generation, tolerance, and clock integrity

· PLL / DLL and clocking architectures

· PVT variation and automotive robustness

· Advanced CMOS processes for high‑speed analog

Highly Desired Experience

· Direct experience with one or more of the following:

- 10GBASE‑T

- 10GBASE‑T1 (Automotive Ethernet)

- TDD‑based transceivers

- Familiarity with automotive semiconductor requirements (AEC‑Q100, temperature, EMI/EMC).

- Experience supporting automotive production ramp and customer qualification.

- Exposure to ISO 26262 / functional safety concepts is a plus.

The base salary range for this position is as mentioned below per year. We also provide competitive benefits, incentive compensation, and/or equity for certain roles.
Company benefits include health. dental, and vision insurance. 401(k), and paid leave. Please note that the base salary range (OR hourly rate) is a guideline, and individual total compensation may vary based on a number of factors such as qualifications, skill level, work location, and other business and organizational needs. As an important part of NXP's Electrification Strategy, the Battery Management Systems (BMS) business is growing into its next phase with the ambition of becoming one of the leading semiconductor suppliers in battery management and energy storage.

Our mission is to continuously create customer value through innovative solutions addressing automotive electrification, industrial energy storage, AI infrastructure, robotics, and future software-defined systems.

The BMS Product Definer Engineer is responsible for translating market opportunities, customer requirements, and future technology trends into product requirements and product specifications for NXP's Battery Management portfolio.

You will work at the intersection of customers, applications engineering, system architecture, marketing, validation, safety, software, and IC development teams to define innovative products that address emerging needs in:

System Architecture Collaboration

- Work closely with System Architects to define end-to-end BMS solutions.
- Evaluate emerging architectures and perform design-space exploration.

Required Qualifications

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in:
- Product Definition
- Systems Engineering
- Semiconductor Product Development
- Battery Management Systems
- Electrification Technologies

- Experience working with:
- Automotive OEMs
- Tier-1 Suppliers
- Battery Manufacturers
- Semiconductor Companies
- Industrial Energy Storage Providers

Experience in customer-facing technical roles is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

Must Have

- Familiarity with automotive development processes and quality requirements.
- Strong analytical and system-thinking skills.

Preferred

- Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
- AI Data Center power architectures.
- Robotics electrification systems.
- Semiconductor architecture definition.
- Mixed-signal IC development.
- Functional safety architecture development.
- Edge connectivity solutions.

Professional Competencies

- Customer-oriented mindset.
- Strategic thinking and product vision.
- Excellent communication skills.
- Ability to influence without direct authority.
- Strong presentation skills.
- Ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
- Leadership and teamwork.
- Self-driven and entrepreneurial mindset.
- Comfortable working in global and multicultural environments.
- Willingness to travel internationally.

Success Metrics

The successful candidate will be measured by:

- Product requirement quality and completeness.
- Customer adoption and design wins.
- Product differentiation versus competitors.
- Roadmap execution effectiveness.
- Accuracy of requirement translation into silicon solutions.
- Internal stakeholder satisfaction.
- Contribution to long-term BMS growth strategy

- Implement AEO strategies to ensure content is well-structured and discoverable by AI-powered search engines and LLMs

Knowledge/ Skills

- CSS3: selectors, advanced styling attributes, media queries, flexbox, and grid layouts
- JavaScript: ability to create custom functions, event handling, and DOM manipulation

- Proven experience with any Content Management System (CMS)

- Familiarity with AEO concepts: optimizing content for featured snippets, AI Overviews, and conversational search engines

- Organized, detail-oriented, and proactive
- Strong analytical and data-handling skills
- Self-driven and able to work well under pressure
- Commitment to on-time deliveries

- Has a strong data-driven mindset, interprets performance metrics, understands why content ranks or doesn't surface in AI-generated responses, and translates that into action
- Understands structured content principles, knows why content architecture (Schema.org, semantic entities, knowledge graphs) matters as much as the content itself, especially for AI discoverability

- Hands-on experience using AI tools in a professional setting required, not optional

- Electronics industry knowledge is a significant plus
- Database knowledge is a significant plus

postings.title: Data Platform Delivery Director
postings.description:
Data Platform Delivery Director

ROLE MANDATE

Build and lead the delivery system that turns NXP enterprise data foundations into trusted, reusable Gold data products. The Director owns a multi-team Foundation delivery organization and orchestrates a federated network of business-domain Gold delivery teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and other domains. The role is accountable for predictable delivery, end-to-end integration, and cross-domain harmonization so that Gold products work as one enterprise data ecosystem rather than as isolated domain solutions.

Role Overview

The Data Platform Delivery Director is responsible for the delivery and evolution of NXP's One Data Platform and the operating model that connects enterprise Foundation capabilities with business-owned Gold data products. This leader manages approximately six delivery teams, typically five to six members each, spanning data engineering, platform engineering, data management, product delivery, and platform operations. The role also coordinates multiple business-side Gold delivery teams that operate as federated spokes and may sit outside the Director's direct reporting line.

Success requires equal strength in scaled delivery leadership, enterprise data architecture, product operating models, and influence across organizational boundaries. The Director establishes clear release contracts from Foundation to Gold, aligns sequencing and dependencies among teams, and ensures that data products created by individual domains conform to shared enterprise standards, canonical definitions, and interoperability requirements.

Accountability

Direct delivery leadership

Lead approximately six Foundation and platform delivery teams of five to six members each, with accountability for capacity, priorities, execution quality, talent development, and delivery outcomes.

Federated domain orchestration

Coordinate business-side Gold delivery teams across Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and additional domains through common planning, governance, architecture, and release mechanisms.

Hub-and-spoke model

Operate the central Foundation organization as the hub that delivers reusable platform capabilities, certified source data, controls, and services. Enable domain teams as spokes that design, build, and own their Gold data products.

Enterprise harmonization

Ensure Gold data products are consistent and interoperable across domains, including shared business definitions, keys, master and reference data, conformed dimensions, quality rules, lineage, and reusable patterns.

Portfolio and dependency management

Maintain an integrated roadmap across Foundation and Gold portfolios, resolve cross-team dependencies, manage delivery risks, and align releases to business priorities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead a Scaled, Multi-Team Delivery Organization

- Provide leadership for approximately six delivery teams, generally five to six members per team, covering the Foundation data layer, platform services, data engineering, data management enablement, and operations.

- Establish a multi-team delivery cadence with clear product ownership, planning horizons, capacity management, dependency tracking, quality gates, release readiness, and transparent outcome reporting.

- Create an environment of strong engineering discipline, accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration across global teams and locations.

- Develop delivery leaders and technical talent, clarify decision rights, and ensure the organization has the skills and capacity required to meet the enterprise roadmap.

2. Establish the Hub-and-Spoke Data Product Delivery Model

- Design and operationalize a hub-and-spoke model in which the central Foundation organization provides reusable platform capabilities, data ingestion, certified foundational data, common services, controls, and enablement to business-domain Gold teams.

- Define the engagement model between the Foundation hub and domain spokes, including intake, prioritization, funding alignment, architecture review, data contracts, service levels, release calendars, support boundaries, and escalation paths.

- Enable Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and other business teams to develop and own Gold data products while ensuring they operate within an enterprise product lifecycle and federated governance model.

- Balance domain autonomy with enterprise consistency, avoiding both centralized bottlenecks and fragmented, duplicative solutions.

3. Harmonize Gold Data Products Across Business Domains

- Own the cross-domain harmonization process for Gold data products and ensure that products developed independently can be combined and consumed consistently across enterprise use cases.

- Drive alignment on canonical business concepts, shared identifiers, conformed dimensions, master and reference data, semantic definitions, calculations, quality expectations, security classifications, and lineage requirements.

- Identify and resolve conflicting definitions, overlapping products, duplicated transformations, and incompatible designs across Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and other domains.

- Establish reusable design patterns and a structured decision forum for cross-domain issues, with documented decisions, accountable owners, and clear exception handling.

- Ensure Gold products are designed for broad consumption by analytics, AI services, agentic solutions, and operational applications.

4. Own Foundation-to-Gold Release Integration

- Define and manage the release interface between Foundation capabilities and Gold data products, including versioned data contracts, readiness criteria, backward compatibility, dependency sequencing, testing, and release communications.

- Maintain an integrated Foundation-to-Gold roadmap and release plan that makes dependencies, constraints, and business impacts visible across all participating teams.

- Coordinate end-to-end testing and production readiness across central and domain teams, including data quality, performance, security, observability, lineage, and operational support.

- Ensure platform and Foundation releases are consumable by Gold teams with appropriate documentation, onboarding, reusable components, and engineering support.

5. Deliver and Evolve the One Data Platform

- Lead the deployment and evolution of NXP's One Data Platform, including data storage and exchange, provisioning, platform operations, Databricks adoption, and self-service enablement.

- Ensure the platform provides reliable and scalable capabilities for data products, analytics, AI, and data sharing, with appropriate security, performance, cost, and operational controls.

- Curate the enabling technology portfolio and continuously improve delivery methods, automation, CI/CD, observability, and platform reliability.

6. Enable Data Management, Marketplace, and Governance

- Enable enterprise capabilities for cataloging, metadata, lineage, asset registration, business glossary, ownership, stewardship, and data quality relationships.

- Own the operational mechanisms for publishing, discovering, requesting, sharing, and supporting data products through the enterprise Data Marketplace.

- Partner with Data Governance and Quality leadership so that governance policies are translated into executable platform controls, delivery checkpoints, product standards, and measurable compliance.

- Advance Data Mesh principles, including domain ownership, data as a product, self-service infrastructure, federated governance, and open data architecture.

7. Manage Stakeholders, Portfolio, and Business Outcomes

- Partner with senior leaders in Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, IT, Data Governance, Architecture, and business transformation teams to translate priorities into an executable, integrated portfolio.

- Facilitate portfolio trade-offs based on enterprise value, readiness, dependencies, risk, capacity, and reuse potential.

- Communicate delivery status, decisions, risks, and outcomes clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences.

- Use outcome-oriented measures to improve predictability, adoption, reuse, data quality, time to value, platform reliability, and cross-domain consistency.

Decision Rights and Accountabilities

- Accountable for the integrated delivery operating model, capacity deployment, execution standards, and release governance across the central delivery organization.

- Accountable for Foundation-to-Gold integration and the mechanisms used to coordinate federated Gold delivery teams.

- Accountable for cross-domain harmonization decisions and escalation of unresolved semantic, architectural, ownership, or delivery conflicts.

- Authority to require remediation or formally approved exceptions when Gold products do not meet enterprise interoperability, quality, security, lineage, or operational standards.

- Jointly accountable with domain owners for adoption and business value of Gold data products, while domain business owners remain accountable for domain priorities, definitions, and product outcomes.

Experience and Qualifications

- Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Typically 10-15 years of relevant experience, including leadership of multiple data, platform, software, or product delivery teams in a complex global enterprise.

- Demonstrated experience leading a scaled delivery organization of approximately 30 or more professionals through managers, team leads, product owners, or matrix leadership.

- Proven ability to coordinate federated teams that do not all report directly to the role and to align business and technology leaders around shared roadmaps, standards, and outcomes.

- Strong knowledge of modern enterprise data platforms, data engineering, cloud data architecture, Data Mesh, data products, metadata, lineage, data quality, semantic models, CI/CD, and platform operations.

- Experience defining and operating product and release models across foundational data layers and business-consumption layers.

- Ability to resolve cross-domain data definition and design conflicts using structured governance, architecture, and stakeholder decision processes.

- Semiconductor industry experience is preferred.

Leadership Profile

Enterprise orchestrator

Connects strategy, architecture, delivery, governance, and business ownership into one executable system.

Scaled delivery leader

Creates clarity and predictable outcomes across multiple teams, competing priorities, and complex dependencies.

Influential collaborator

Builds durable partnerships and drives alignment across business and IT organizations without relying solely on direct authority.

Product and platform thinker

Balances reusable enterprise foundations with fast, accountable domain product delivery.

Decisive harmonizer

Surfaces conflicts early, creates fact-based choices, and drives decisions that serve enterprise outcomes over local optimization.

Effective communicator

Adapts communication for executive, business, product, engineering, architecture, and governance audiences.

Talent builder

Develops leaders and teams, promotes psychological safety, and raises engineering and product-delivery maturity.

Measures of Success

- Predictable delivery and release performance across Foundation and domain Gold portfolios.

- Reduced cross-team blockers, late dependency discovery, rework, and release instability.

- Increased reuse of certified Foundation data, shared components, canonical definitions, and enterprise Gold products.

- Measurable improvement in Gold product interoperability, quality, lineage, adoption, and time to value.

- Clear ownership, decision rights, service expectations, and escalation paths across the hub-and-spoke network.

- Reliable, secure, observable, and cost-effective platform operations that support analytics and AI at enterprise scale.

Job Title: Distribution Business Manager (DBM)

Job Position: GLOBAL SALES ACCOUNT MANAGER SIP

Location: Central US – Austin TX, Novi MI, Chicago IL, Home Based (must be located in Central US)

Role Summary:

As a Distribution Business Manager, you are the strategic leader of your assigned territory, responsible for driving NXP’s growth through our distribution partners. You will maintain intimate knowledge of significant accounts and prioritize your territory growth plan accordingly. This includes partnering closely with distribution resources to achieve results in revenue growth, funnel development, design win acceleration, and customer expansion.

Job Responsibility:

- Own and execute territory growth strategies aligned with NXP’s Intelligent Edge vision, driving market share and customer expansion.

- Forge strong partnerships with distribution leaders, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with branch General Managers to ensure alignment and performance.

- Develop joint business plans with distribution partners, integrating demand creation initiatives, targeted seminars, and tailored engagement strategies to accelerate design wins and market penetration.

- Deliver a consistent training cadence for distribution teams, covering NPIs and NXP solutions tailored to local market needs to strengthen technical expertise (FAEs) and sales effectiveness (FSRs).

- Lead execution of local and corporate-driven marketing campaigns in collaboration with distribution partners to amplify NXP’s presence and generate measurable funnel growth.

- Perform regular funnel reviews, capture critical actions, and drive follow-up on must-win opportunities to ensure pipeline health and conversion.

- Engage in joint customer visits with distribution personnel to advance strategic opportunities and expand account relationships.

- Serve as the escalation point for technical and commercial issues, coordinating with product lines and field resources to resolve challenges quickly.

- Drive internal alignment across NXP stakeholders, ensuring responsiveness, technical support, and seamless execution for channel success.

Job Qualification:

- BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or related field.

- Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding sales quotas.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in semiconductor technical sales, distribution management, or field applications engineering.

- Strong technical aptitude and ability to stay current with evolving technologies (processing, connectivity, analog).

- Excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

- Willingness to travel (primarily domestic).

Preferred Skills:

- Minimum 2 years of experience with distribution management and QBR processes.

- Familiarity with CRM tools, funnel management, and opportunity review best practices.

- Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and distribution stakeholders.

- Familiarity with embedded computing architectures, including MCU, MPU, and accelerator technologies (NPU), and how they are applied in edge systems.

- Exposure to AI-enabled systems, with basic understanding of Edge AI concepts across the complete solution from data to deployment, including model development considerations, deployment constraints, and on-device inference requirements.

NXP Introduction:

AI is rapidly moving beyond research labs and into the real world—powering advancements in vehicles, factories, hospitals, homes, and everyday devices. NXP’s Global Sales organization is the force that transforms our intelligent edge vision into meaningful market impact. We operate on the front lines of innovation, delivering real‑world AI, secure edge intelligence, and breakthrough technologies to the customers shaping tomorrow’s world. As a strategic partner at the intersection of customer ambition and NXP capability, our global sales team drives alignment, opens new markets, and builds the relationships that lead to design wins and revenue growth. Through deep market insight and long‑term collaboration, we embed customer‑centricity into every decision and help accelerate innovation at the system‑solution level. This disciplined, client‑first mindset enables us to architect integrated, future‑ready solutions that deliver sustained value and strengthen NXP’s competitive advantage. We thrive in a high‑performance, high‑ownership environment—competing boldly, executing with urgency, and celebrating results. If you want to win big, grow fast, and work with the customers building what’s next, NXP Global Sales is where ambition becomes achievement. For more information, please visit our website https://www.nxp.com

The future starts here. Bright Minds. Bright Futures.

postings.title: Dry Etch Proces Engineer
postings.description:
Introduction

Are you the process engineer who is a team player looking for a dynamic high-tech work environment? Where you grow to a leading role in executing and improving technical tool processes, using your analytical toolbox to optimize our fab performance? We might be looking for you!

NXP Semiconductors N.V. provides High Performance Mixed Signal and Standard Product solutions that leverage its leading RF, Analog, Power Management, Interface, Security and Digital Processing expertise. These innovations are used in a wide range of automotive, identification, wireless infrastructure, lighting, industrial, mobile, consumer and computing applications. A global semiconductor company with operations in more than 35 countries, over 45.000 employees and a revenue of over $10 billion.

ICN8 is the largest 8“integrated circuits wafers fab in Europe. It is a high-tech environment with many multi discipline challenges, housing over 600+ manufacturing tools (ASML, ASM/TEL, Applied Materials, LAM) and 150 measurement tools (inline inspections, end of inline testing). Products are made in CMOS, BIMOS, RFCMOS and SOI processes. In the coming 5 years several new processes will be transferred to our fab which enables further growth.

Job Mission

Supports the Equipment and Process Engineering (EPE) organization by maintaining, initiating and implementing technical improvements and supporting the Manufacturing organization.

Job Description

Reports to an Engineering section manager. Supports Manufacturing and Process Sustaining and Enhancement (PSE). As Process Engineer you are responsible for process performance with special focus on the more complex problems. Besides problem analyzing and solving you will actively develop and introduce process improvement on product quality, throughput, scrap-reduction, cost savings and reduction of repeaters.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

- Responsible to maintain and provide up-to-date procedures and processes, that meet the safety and quality requirements of NXP and comply with the applicable standards. And validation on the shop floor.
- Proactively connects with Manufacturing and transfers improvement ideas concerning structural technical problems, material quality issues and bottlenecks into improvement actions, involve other sections and departments if applicable and drive these actions until successful implementation
- Use technical knowledge and experience to contribute in improvement projects
- Define the required quantity and secure the availability of production tools, initiate upgrades, support maintenance actions and solve safety issues
- Coordinates quality related escalations to customers and support Manufacturing in securing production progress.

Education

BSc. or MSc. level in Physics, Chemistry or other relevant technical area.

Experience

- Preferably experience in a high-tech/semiconductor environment
- Preferably experience with plasma based processing
- Knowledge of complex production processes
- Languages: Dutch and English
- Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, process optimization, statistical process control, FMEA and Quality Management Systems (preferred)

Personal skills

- Raising the bar; Analytical, pragmatic, pro-active and customer oriented
- Engages curiosity; Self-assured and able to engage and convince people, also at higher management levels
- Takes initiative; shows ownership, hands on mentality
- Working together; Is a reliable team player, listens to and absorbs other ideas and opinions. Good social/communication skills on different levels
- Developing deep core competences; Is a quick learner, able to prioritize and operate independently and adapt to changing circumstances focusing on quality and continuous improvement

​ Creating Secure Connections and Infrastructure for a Smarter World

NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ: NXPI) makes products and environments safer, more sustainable, and more secure with innovative connectivity and edge processing solutions for a smarter world.

We are in the business of better. Not just better technologies, but better innovations to improve society. As the world leader in secure connectivity and processing solutions for embedded applications, NXP is solving the world’s most complex technology challenges to accelerate business innovation, enhance how we work, and advance how we live.

Ready to create a smarter world? Visit our career website and follow us on social: LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter.

A bonus plan, the possibility to purchase extra holidays, an excellent pension plan, a work from home policy, and the possibility to buy company shares with a 15% discount are some examples. postings.title: ESD Design Expert
postings.description:
Role Summary

The ACC CTO ESD/EMC Team drives robustness excellence across NXP's product portfolio by enabling First-Pass-Right product development through advanced EMC and ESD methodologies, innovative design solutions, validation capabilities, and technology leadership.

As an ESD Design Expert, you will serve as a recognized technical leader responsible for defining and deploying advanced ESD protection solutions across multiple product lines and semiconductor technologies. Leveraging your extensive experience in analog IC design, ESD protection, and product robustness, you will influence architecture decisions, drive innovation, mentor engineers, and shape the future ESD & EMC strategy for NXP's automotive and industrial products.

You will collaborate closely with technology development, product lines, validation teams, package engineering, and system architects to deliver highly robust and competitive semiconductor solutions.

ESD: ElectroStatic Discharge, EMC: ElectroMagnetic Compatibility

Responsibilities

- Define and drive ESD protection strategies, architectures, and roadmaps for new product families and emerging technologies.

- Lead the design, optimization, and validation of advanced on-chip ESD protection solutions for analog, mixed-signal, high-voltage, and automotive integrated circuits.

- Establish ESD design methodologies, rules, best practices, and reusable design libraries across the organization.

- Provide technical leadership during product development, ensuring First-Pass-Right robustness while balancing reliability, performance, silicon area, power consumption, and cost.

- Drive ESD sign-off reviews and support critical design decisions across multiple development programs.

- Lead complex ESD investigations, characterization campaigns, failure analysis activities, and root-cause assessments.

- Partner with EMC experts to develop holistic chip and system-level robustness solutions.

- Collaborate with technology development teams to define future ESD devices and process capabilities.

- Develop advanced simulation, modeling, automation, and AI-assisted methodologies to improve design efficiency and predict robustness issues earlier in the development cycle.

- Act as the technical interface for customer escalations and strategic robustness challenges.

- Drive innovation through patents, publications, university partnerships, and technology research programs.

- Mentor and coach design engineers, fostering technical excellence and knowledge sharing across the organization.

Profile

Education

- Master's Degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Skills

- 10 to 20 years of experience in ESD protection design, or analog/mixed-signal IC design,
- EMC-aware analog design knowledge is a plus.
- Deep expertise in semiconductor device physics and analog integrated circuit design.
- Proven experience developing ESD protection solutions for analog, mixed-signal, high-voltage, power management, automotive products, or communication transceivers.
- Strong knowledge of ESD and robustness standards including HBM, CDM, IEC 61000-4-2, ISO 10605, TLP, VF-TLP, latch-up, and system-level ESD requirements.
- Extensive experience with EDA simulation tools, device modeling, and silicon debug.
- Strong understanding of chip-package-system interactions and robustness challenges.
- Experience with advanced technologies such as CMOS, BCD, SOI, FinFET, or high-voltage processes.
- Proven track record of solving complex reliability and robustness challenges in production products.
- Experience leading technical projects and influencing cross-functional engineering teams.

Personal Skills

- Recognized technical leadership and ability to influence strategic decisions.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to complex technical challenges.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to work effectively across global and multidisciplinary organization
- Strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.
- Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and technology leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

- Recognized expert in ESD, EMC, or analog IC design.

- Experience in automotive functional safety and high-reliability semiconductor products.

- Track record of patents, technical publications, conference presentations, or industry contributions.

- Experience defining corporate design methodologies, standards, or technology roadmaps.

- Knowledge of AI-assisted circuit design, automation, data analytics, or machine learning applications for semiconductor development.

Impact

In this role, you will play a key role in shaping NXP's ESD robustness strategy, enabling industry-leading reliability and First-Pass-Right success for next-generation automotive and industrial semiconductor solutions. As a technical expert within the ACC CTO organization, you will influence technologies, products, methodologies, and engineering excellence across the company.

The car is becoming a computer on wheels, and AI is moving from the cloud to the edge; right onto silicon. Our S32N automotive MPUs pack proprietary AI IP blocks that let carmakers run machine learning where it matters: in the vehicle, in real-time, safely.

postings.title: Internship: Phase-Noise-Resilient Architectures for Large MIMO FMCW Automotive Radars
postings.description:
Job Responsibility:

The internship focuses on the exploration and evaluation of next-generation automotive radar architectures that combine the benefits of large-scale MIMO imaging and phased-array beam steering.

- Investigate the impact of phase noise accumulation and multipath propagation in large MIMO FMCW radar systems employing DDMA and related techniques.

- Develop mathematical models and simulation frameworks to analyze radar system performance, including angle resolution, Doppler resolution, detection capability, and phase-noise robustness.

- Research and evaluate hybrid radar architectures that combine MIMO imaging capability with directional phased-array transmission.

- Explore beam-scanning strategies, DDMA-based transmission schemes, sparse transmit activation methods, and subarray-based beamforming concepts.

- Design and perform MATLAB and/or Python simulations to compare alternative radar architectures and quantify associated system trade-offs.

Project Deliverables

- Literature review on MIMO radar, phased-array radar, DDMA processing, and phase-noise effects.

- Simulation framework for evaluating hybrid radar architectures.

- Analysis of trade-offs between angular resolution, Doppler resolution, frame rate, phase-noise robustness, and implementation complexity.

- Evaluation of array configurations, beam scheduling approaches, and waveform design alternatives.

- Final technical report and presentation summarizing findings and recommendations.

Learning Objectives

During this internship, the student will gain hands-on experience in:

- Advanced FMCW automotive radar systems and signal processing.

- MIMO radar, phased-array beamforming, and imaging radar concepts.

- Array signal processing and direction-of-arrival estimation techniques.

- System-level radar architecture design and performance optimization.

- Research methodologies involving theoretical analysis, simulation, and engineering trade-off evaluation.

Job Qualification:

- The candidate must be pursuing a Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

- Strong interest in radar systems, wireless communications, signal processing, and sensing technologies.

- Familiarity with FMCW radar, MIMO radar, phased arrays, beamforming, antenna arrays, and RF impairments such as phase noise is highly beneficial.

- Good understanding of FFT-based processing, range-Doppler processing, detection theory, estimation theory, array signal processing, and direction-of-arrival estimation.

- Experience with MATLAB and/or Python for modeling, simulation, visualization, and algorithm development.

- Knowledge of structured software development practices and version control tools such as Git is a plus.

- Self-motivated, curious, analytical, and comfortable working on open research questions with both independent and collaborative work styles.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical findings and present results clearly.

postings.description:
About the role

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented IT Internal Auditor to join our global Internal Audit team. This role provides global exposure and the opportunity to contribute to IT audits and other types of engagements across a wide range of systems, technologies, and business functions. You will work closely with stakeholders to strengthen IT governance, risk management, cybersecurity, and operational resilience, while also supporting emerging areas such as AI and digital innovation. This role is based in Petaling Jaya, Malaysia.

Key responsibilities

IT Audit execution

- Support risk-based audits across global systems, applications, cloud and infrastructure environments.
- Contribute to end-to-end audit engagements, including planning, fieldwork, testing, and documentation.
- Assess the design and effectiveness of internal controls across global Information Technology (IT) and Information Security (IS) processes.
- Prepare clear, concise and high-quality audit documentation and draft reports aligned with global standards.
- Support the communication of audit findings through written reports and discussions with relevant stakeholders.
- Track and follow up on implementation of corrective actions to ensure timely and consistent remediation.

Advisory & other engagements

- Analyze data and processes to identify IT / IS risks, control gaps, and improvement opportunities.
- Collaborate with IT and business teams to enhance processes, internal (system) controls, data integrity and operational efficiency.
- Lead and facilitate walkthroughs, risk assessments, and control design discussions, ensuring accurate and complete documentation (e.g., RCMs, narratives, flowcharts).
- Support IT advisory activities, including system implementations, digital transformation initiatives and process automation.
- Participate in AI-related and advanced analytics engagements, including assessing governance, risks, and controls over AI models, data usage, and automation.
- Contribute to cross-functional (non-IT) projects, providing a broader business perspective.

Drive internal audit improvements

- Identify opportunities to enhance audit quality, efficiency, and consistency.
- Contribute to innovation initiatives including the use of data analytics, automation, and emerging technologies (incl. AI) to strengthen the Internal Audit function.
- Support the development of modern IT audit methodologies, particularly for emerging technologies and digital processes.

Your Profile

- Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Internal Audit, Accounting, or related discipline.
- 3-5 years of relevant experience in IT Audit, Internal Audit, IT Risk, or similar roles.
- Experience in a Big 4 or IT audit/consulting environment is a plus.
- Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CEH or relevant IT certifications are preferred.

Your main qualities and skills are:

- Understanding of IT control frameworks (COBIT, NIST etc.) and internal control principles.
- Knowledge of IT general controls, cybersecurity, cloud and system risks.
- Interest in emerging technologies, including AI, data analytics, and automation, with a willingness to develop expertise in these areas.
- Strong analytical skills and ability to translate technical risks into clear, actionable insights.
- Effective communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.
- Proactive, curious, and eager to learn and adapt in a fast-evolving technology landscape.
- Proficiency in English is required

Why Join Us

- Gain broad exposure to global IT / IS environments and initiatives, and AI-related engagements.
- Work closely with IT, cybersecurity, cloud, data, and business teams across geographies.
- Opportunities for career development and professional certification support.
- Collaborative and inclusive culture focused on learning, innovation and continuous improvement.

- Moderate travel (~20%).

postings.title: Manufacturing Support Engineer (Ploegendienst)
Master Thesis Internship – Intelligent Thread across Semiconductor Product Lifecycle
postings.description:
Our Vision

The most powerful AI use cases need smart contexts, through an Intelligent Thread.
A thread that connects knowledge and expertise, materialized in data, from various business functions and domains, across the full Product Lifecycle.

From marketing and design, sales and operations, to delivery and service. From hundreds of ideas, thousands of designs, millions of recipes, to billions of devices. Produced in physical and digital factories. Used, out in the field, like in cars, drones, and robots.

Today, knowledge and expertise across functions and domains is scattered, fragmented. Rather than viewing the Intelligent Thread as a mechanism for traceability, this project explores how it can become an active engineering knowledge and learning system.

A continuously evolving foundation that provides domain specific contexts, enables deployment of AI agents, supports knowledge exchange, informed decision making, and organizational learning throughout the Product Lifecycle.

Our Team

Your will join the Product Lifecycle Solutions team, an enthusiastic group of Business focused IT professionals, working from Eindhoven, Netherlands, and Bangalore, India. Operating in the global, highly competitive, highly dynamic Semiconductor industry.

Stepping up to challenges in the Product Lifecycle space, enabling NXP success, at high speed. You will work from the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven. You will be able also to catch-up with master thesis students in other areas, like Supply Chain and Quality.

Your Assignment

Phase 1

Phase 1 focuses on understanding NXP's current Digital/Intelligent Thread and identifying opportunities to strengthen it as an engineering knowledge and learning system. Through stakeholder interviews, process analysis, and exploration of the existing PLM ecosystem, the student will investigate:

- How engineering knowledge and expertise flows across the product lifecycle
- Which engineering artifacts, decisions, and rationale are connected, and where important knowledge gaps exist
- Challenges in (the speed of) knowledge exchange, change management, and cross-domain collaboration
- Opportunities to improve how engineering knowledge is captured, connected, maintained, and reused throughout the product lifecycle

The outcome will be an assessment of the current Intelligent Thread from a knowledge and learning perspective, together with a prioritized set of research directions, that will form the basis for the master's thesis.

Phase 2

Building on Phase 1 findings, Phase 2 focuses to investigate one selected challenge and to design, prototype, or evaluate a concrete solution that strengthens the Intelligent Thread, as an active engineering knowledge and learning system.

Possible research directions include:

- Engineering knowledge representation and integration
- Continuous traceability and knowledge evolution
- Cross-domain change impact analysis
- Capturing and preserving engineering rationale
- Cross-domain engineering decision support
- Knowledge discovery and reuse across the product lifecycle

Artificial Intelligence, including agentic AI, knowledge graphs, or other intelligent technologies may be explored, where appropriate as enabling technologies.
Nevertheless, the primary focus is on improving the Intelligent Thread as a living engineering knowledge and learning system, that supports faster and smarter engineering decision making, throughout the Product Lifecycle.

Your Profile

Master Thesis student, preferably in one the following areas:

- Industrial Engineering and Innovation
- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
- Data Science or Computer Science
- Operations and Logistics Management

Including the following skills:

- Open, innovative and collaborative mindset
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Strong communication skills, navigating across cultures and functions
- Excellent in English language
- Python would be good to get, while SPARQL is a nice to have

Our Offering

- Conducting your master thesis research,
- based on an internship contract

- Interesting/challenging working environment,
- in a global operating company
- in a highly competitive high-tech industry
- with a wide variety of development and learning opportunities

NXP Semiconductors enables secure connections and infrastructure for a smarter world, advancing solutions that make lives easier, better and safer. As a Compiler Engineer in the NXP Global Compiler Team you will be providing compiler tools for a variety of embedded processors and using both proprietary and open-source compiler technologies. The silicon enablement team provides software development tools for advanced automotive SOCs (system-on-chip). These tools enable both pre-silicon and production software development for automotive SOCs.

Your Responsibilities

- Design and implement AI/ML compiler technologies, optimizing models for embedded hardware using C++ and LLVM to deliver high‑performance inference across diverse semiconductor platforms.
- Design and implement features related to compiler tools for ARM and RISC-V based CPU cores using compiler technology.
- Work in a technical role in compiler development, working with core architecture design teams as well as internal NXP compiler tools consumers.
- Work together with a worldwide development team contributing to design, development, and deployment cycle for NXP specific compiler features in the compiler framework
- Work closely with hardware architects and ML researchers, shaping how models are lowered, optimized, and executed on novel architectures. Strong focus on MLIR / graph compilers and end-to-end performance optimization.

Your Profile

- University degree: Computer Science / Computer Engineering with significant exposure/involvement with Machine Learning, Edge AI, and Embedded Systems
- You have 5+ years of professional experience in compiler technologies (LLVM/MLIR, LLVM IR, Clang, LLVM Pass Framework, Optimization Pipelines, Code Generation, Linkers)
- Experience with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) and software stack (e.g., ONNX, MLIR, XLA, TVM, TensorRT, etc.)
- Expertise in writing production quality Python and C++ code
- Be able to analyze problems in complex compiler code bases and come up with concise, accurate solutions in a timely fashion.
- Experience in graph compiler passes optimization for AI workloads, lowering models (PyTorch / TensorFlow) into efficient IR
- Experience with graph-level optimizations (fusion, tiling, scheduling)
- Experience in analyzing compiler generated code using simulators, profilers, and analysis tools to improve code generation quality
- Embedded systems programming experience and knowledge of the requirements of compilers for embedded systems.
- Understanding of computer architecture, including caches, pipelines, and instruction set architectures
- Good communication skills and be able to work effectively with remote teams in a worldwide virtual work environment
- Experience with contributing to the open-source community

postings.title: N1 AMHS Equipment Technician
postings.description:
Job Description

Primary Responsibilities:

- The candidate(s) selected will be responsible for performing scheduled and unscheduled maintenance in the ATMC AMHS Equipment area.

- Maintain, repair, upgrade, and monitor AMHS equipment including PRI 7000 & Turbo Stockers, PRI Guardian Reticle Stockers, PRI Aerotrak systems and Daifuku parts management systems

- The tasks include, but are not limited to, troubleshooting and repair of electrical/electronic systems, pneumatic and mechanical systems, scheduled maintenance, consumable changes, and various other activities relevant to the success of the area.

- Complete documentation and train others on equipment maintenance.

- While performing the duties of this job, the applicant will be required to communicate effectively using both written and verbal skills

- The applicant will also be required to stand for long periods of time (up to 12 hours) and should be physically able to do so in addition to occasionally stooping and or crawling in confined spaces

- The applicant must be able to lift and carry objects up to 50 pounds.

Qualifications:

- Education Requirements: AS, AAS in electronics or other industrial engineering, or related is preferred. Education requirements can be satisfied by equivalent experience.

- Specific knowledge of the Maintenance job functions are required. Minimum of 8 years of experience in the semiconductor industry.

- AA degree in Electronics or related discipline and 5 years technical maintenance experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience may be acceptable.

- Minimum 5 years of experience with the Metrology/Defect area.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills and demonstrate excellent problem-solving skills

- Solid understanding of both SPC and FDC and work to improve overall equipment performance based on these types of controls

- Problem solving skills and have excellent interaction and communication with all Operations and Engineering personnel

- Ability to interface with other internal and external groups to ensure all safety, performance, and reliability requirements are satisfied

Roles and Responsibilities

- Participate in the definition and deployment of next-generation SoC integration methodologies and infrastructure.
- Work with software and firmware teams to ensure smooth handoff of register maps, memory maps, and hardware configuration data.
- Take ownership of specific integration domains while aligning deliverables with global methodology and project requirements.
- Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership in SoC integration methodologies, IP-XACT adoption, and automation development.
- Contribute to methodology roadmap initiatives focused on improving design reuse, automation, scalability, and integration quality across multiple SoC programs.

Preferred Skills

- Experience with IP-XACT (IEEE 1685) standard and metadata-driven design methodologies.
- Expertise in Magillem and/or Defacto-based SoC assembly flows.
- Experience with register generation tools (CSRCompiler, RgGen, SystemRDL-based flows, or equivalent).
- Familiarity with FPGA prototyping, emulation environments, and virtual platforms.
- Understanding of SoC bring-up, validation, and post-silicon integration requirements.
- Exposure to AI/ML-assisted design automation and methodology development is a plus.

Your team

You will closely work with a highly experienced, international, cross functional team of engineers.  Part of the eIQ AI Runtime team, we are striving for Total Quality for end-to-end safe and secure products to our customers We are driven by NXP core values: raising the bar, engaging curiosity, taking initiative, working together, and developing deep core competence

- Experience with NPU or AI accelerator integration in embedded systems.

- Experience integrating software into large, layered automotive software stacks.
- Strong understanding of hardware-software interfaces, memory-mapped I/O, and DMA

- Experience with AI/ML inference frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, ONNX Runtime) in embedded automotive contexts.
- Knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262), ASPICE, and MISRA compliance.
- Exposure to ADAS, sensor fusion, or Audio algorithm with AIML software stacks.
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control (Git), and agile development methodologies
- Familiarity with dsp/ HiFi5 /accelerator firmware/driver development, performance optimization, multicore or similar type of programming.

Creating Secure Connections and Infrastructure for a Smarter World

NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ: NXPI) makes products and environments safer, more sustainable, and more secure with innovative connectivity and edge processing solutions for a smarter world.

We are in the business of better. Not just better technologies, but better innovations to improve society. postings.title: Operator Techniek
postings.description:
Operator Techniek

NXP is een internationale chipproducent met meer dan 30.000 medewerkers wereldwijd. De fabriek in Nijmegen behoort tot de grootste halfgeleiderfabrieken van Europa en produceert jaarlijks miljarden chips voor de Automotive, Mobile en Industrial markt.

Ben jij een kwaliteitsbewuste Operator die graag werkt in een hightech productieomgeving?

Binnen onze organisatie spelen Operators een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze productietools. Ben jij nauwkeurig, technisch onderlegd en continu op zoek naar verbeteringen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat kan je verwachten?

- Een uitgebreide inwerkperiode waarbij je wordt opgeleid in onze processen, systemen en veiligheidsmethodieken.
- Werken in een moderne hightech omgeving met geavanceerde productieapparatuur.
- Intensieve begeleiding door ervaren collega's en vakinhoudelijke trainingen.
- Veel ruimte om technische kennis op te bouwen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.
- Een afwisselende functie met zowel preventief onderhoud als verbeteractiviteiten.
- Werken binnen een team waarin samenwerking, veiligheid en kwaliteit centraal staan.
- Mogelijkheden om aanvullende opleidingen en functiegerichte trainingen te volgen.
- Een informele werksfeer waarin continu verbeteren wordt gestimuleerd.

Verantwoordelijkheden

- Uitvoeren van preventieve onderhouds- en cleaning activiteiten om de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van productietools te waarborgen.
- Uitvoeren van revisies aan apparatuur en onderdelen volgens vastgestelde kwaliteitsnormen en werkvoorschriften.
- Controleren van PM-kits op volledigheid en visuele afwijkingen bij ontvangst en verzending.
- Signaleren en zelfstandig doorvoeren van verbeteringen aan bestaande preventieve onderhoudsprocedures.
- Zorgdragen voor een correcte administratieve vastlegging van uitgevoerde werkzaamheden.
- Samenwerken met collega's van Manufacturing, Engineering en andere ondersteunende afdelingen om de continuïteit van het productieproces te waarborgen.
- Direct actie ondernemen bij onveilige situaties en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving.
- Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden conform de geldende Arbo-, Safety-, ESH- en milieuregelgeving.
- Verrichten van risicovolle werkzaamheden waarvoor je bent opgeleid en vrijgegeven.
- Bijdragen aan een cultuur van continue verbetering op het gebied van veiligheid, kwaliteit en efficiëntie.

Dit breng jij mee

- Een afgeronde relevante technische opleiding op minimaal mbo-3 niveau.
- Kwaliteitsbewust, nauwkeurig en gestructureerd in je werkzaamheden.
- Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands is een must.
- In staat je verstaanbaar te maken in het Engels.
- Ervaring met of vaardigheid in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel en Outlook).
- Gedisciplineerde werkhouding en affiniteit met het werken volgens procedures en instructies.
- Flexibiliteit ten aanzien van werktijden en eventuele ploegwisselingen.
- Bereid om indien noodzakelijk ook buiten reguliere werktijden ondersteuning te bieden.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

- Direct een vast contract.
- 26 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om 20 extra dagen bij te kopen)
- Green mobility: NS Business card voor dagelijks vervoer van/ en naar werk of eventueel fietsplan beschikbaar
- Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden.
- Een gedegen inwerktraject met begeleiding door ervaren collega's.
- Werken in een innovatieve en internationale hightech omgeving.

postings.title: PhD Position (f/m/d) - Memory-Centric NPU Architectures and Emerging Memory Technologies for Edge AI
postings.description:
As AI models continue to grow in size and complexity, memory subsystems are emerging as a fundamental bottleneck in modern AI accelerators. The efficiency of future NPU-based systems will increasingly depend on how data is stored, moved, and processed across the memory hierarchy.

We are looking for a PhD candidate to work on Memory-Centric NPU Architectures and Emerging Memory Technologies for Edge AI. This PhD project focuses on exploring memory-centric AI accelerator architectures that integrate advanced NPUs with emerging memory technologies such as eDRAM and next-generation embedded memories. The goal is to develop innovative hardware/software co-design methodologies that improve performance, power efficiency, memory utilization, and scalability for future edge AI and embedded Generative AI systems.

In this role, you will focus on the following research directions:

- Memory-Centric NPU Architecture Design: Investigate memory-centric NPU subsystem architectures that improve performance, scalability, and energy efficiency for future AI workloads.
- Emerging Memory Technologies for AI Acceleration: Evaluate and model emerging memory technologies such as eDRAM, GCRAM, and other next-generation embedded memories for future AI accelerators. Analyze their impact on performance, power consumption, silicon area, reliability, and scalability.
- Hardware/Software Co-Optimization for AI Workloads: Develop hardware/software co-optimization techniques for efficient execution of AI workloads on NPU-based systems.
- Design Space Exploration and Performance Modeling: Develop architecture exploration frameworks that enable rapid evaluation of future AI subsystem designs and quantify trade-offs across performance, power, area, memory utilization, and workload characteristics.

You will work at the intersection of computer architecture, semiconductor memory systems, AI accelerators, embedded systems, and machine learning, helping shape the next generation of NXP AI processors.

In this PhD, you will:

- Conduct research on next-generation NPU subsystem architectures
- Develop architectural modeling and simulation frameworks
- Investigate the integration of emerging memory technologies into AI accelerators
- Build performance, power, and area (PPA) evaluation methodologies for AI hardware design
- Evaluate real-world AI workloads including CNNs, Transformers, LLMs, VLMs, and multimodal AI systems
- Analyze trade-offs across performance, power, memory bandwidth, silicon area, scalability, and reliability
- Publish results in leading conferences and journals
- Collaborate with experts in semiconductor design, system architecture, AI acceleration, and embedded AI

Your Profile:

- A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Embedded Systems, or a related field
- Strong background in one or more of the following:
- computer architecture
- digital design
- embedded systems
- semiconductor memory systems
- AI accelerators and NPUs
- hardware/software co-design
- digital hardware design

- Experience with Python and C/C++
- Knowledge of computer architecture simulation, performance modeling, or hardware design methodologies
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Very good written and spoken English

The following experiences would be considered a plus:

- AI accelerator and NPU architecture
- RTL development using Verilog/SystemVerilog/VHDL
- FPGA prototyping
- Computer architecture simulators
- Memory hierarchy optimization
- eDRAM, GCRAM, MRAM, ReRAM, or CXL-based memory systems

What you can expect:

At NXP, you will work on research that directly contributes to future generations of AI processing hardware. You will have access to state-of-the-art NPU architectures, architecture simulation frameworks, advanced semiconductor design methodologies, and emerging memory technologies currently being investigated for future AI products. You will collaborate with experts in AI hardware architecture, Digital IP design, memory systems, and machine learning while contributing to technologies that can influence future NXP Edge AI and Generative AI processors.

This PhD offers a unique opportunity to combine cutting-edge academic research with high industrial relevance and to contribute directly to the development of next-generation AI hardware architectures.

Please note that this is a contract in part-time (80%), limited to 3 years.

Please note: The successful candidate may/will be responsible for security related tasks. The assignment may/will be in scope of security certifications, therefore a conscious and reliable way of working is necessary.

The Analog Validation Engineer / Architect is responsible for comprehensive validation of key product indicators (KPI's) as defined in the system compliance matrix for all analog circuitry in any given platform. This also means reporting out those measurements in the most concise, clear and comprehensive possible ways.
