- Write software to configure device under test (DUT) for required test cases.

- Create hardware automation sequences to perform parametric measurements over process, voltage, temperature, and DUT configurations.

- Analyze parametric data to report pass/fail/margin to electrical specs and generate summary reports.

- Interface with Design, Product & Test Engineering, Applications, Software, Product Analysis teams to debug IP-related issues.

- Research and recommend hardware required to perform required measurements.

- Generate hardware design requirements and participate in schematic and layout reviews.

Job Qualification:

- Bachelor or Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science with a minimum of 12 years of industry experience.

- Experience with high-speed/RF lab equipment including oscilloscopes, BER testers, vector network analyzers, phase noise analyzers.

- C programming experience. TestStand and Python a plus.

- Data analysis using Excel, JMP, and/or PowerBI.

- Debug of hardware setups and schematic reading.

- Familiarity with SerDes validation and Ethernet IEEE 802.3 and PCIe protocols desired

- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail for an understanding of silicon, board, and software interactions.

- Able to debug silicon and signal integrity issues.

- AI prompting for software generation a plus.

postings.title: Principal Engineer – NPU Compiler & Architecture
postings.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Compiler / Software Architect to join our NPU Hardware Architecture team and play a key role in the hardware-software co-design of next-generation AI inference accelerators.

This is a unique role at the intersection of NPU hardware architecture, AI compilers, performance modeling, and software development. The position will work directly with hardware architects to define, evaluate, and prototype the software stack required to program current and future NPU architectures.

Our NPU architecture is closely coupled with the compiler stack. Efficient utilization of the accelerator requires deep understanding of the hardware compute architecture, memory hierarchy, dataflow, scheduling, quantization, instruction set and execution model. The successful candidate will use this understanding to develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts, evaluate architectural proposals against real AI workloads, and influence the design of future NPU hardware.

You will work closely with hardware architects, micro-architects, compiler engineers and AI software teams to answer a fundamental question:

How should the NPU hardware and software be co-designed to deliver the best performance, power efficiency, programmability and scalability for real-world AI workloads?

What You Will Be Responsible For

Compiler & Software Architecture for NPU

- Develop compiler and software proof-of-concepts for current and next-generation NPU architectures.
- Define software abstractions and compiler flows that efficiently expose NPU hardware capabilities to AI workloads.
- Develop and evaluate compiler concepts including graph lowering, intermediate representations, operator mapping, scheduling, tiling, fusion, memory planning and code generation.
- Translate NPU architectural concepts into executable software models and demonstrate their feasibility using representative AI workloads.
- Develop lightweight compiler/runtime infrastructure to validate new hardware features before production software implementation.
- Analyze existing compiler limitations and identify architectural changes required to improve programmability and accelerator utilization.

Hardware–Software Co-Design

- Work as an integral member of the hardware architecture team to co-design NPU hardware and software.
- Analyze how proposed hardware features can be effectively exposed through the compiler and software stack.
- Provide software-driven feedback on compute architecture, memory hierarchy, data movement, dataflow, scheduling, instruction set and accelerator programmability.
- Identify hardware features that provide meaningful benefits to real AI workloads and challenge features that add hardware complexity without sufficient software value.
- Define compiler requirements and software abstractions for new NPU capabilities.
- Participate in architecture and micro-architecture reviews and influence hardware decisions from a software and workload perspective.
- Evaluate architectural trade-offs considering performance, power, area, compiler complexity and software scalability.

AI Workload & Performance Analysis

- Analyze representative AI models and workloads to identify compute, memory, bandwidth, scheduling and data-movement bottlenecks.
- Build software-based performance models and workload prototypes to evaluate architectural concepts.
- Develop experiments to quantify the impact of proposed hardware features on model performance and accelerator utilization.
- Investigate issues such as quantization, sparsity, operator fusion, tensor layouts, tiling, data reuse, memory bandwidth and scheduling efficiency.
- Correlate software/model-level performance with architectural and micro-architectural behavior.
- Use workload analysis to guide both current-generation optimizations and next-generation NPU architecture.

Architecture Prototyping

- Rapidly prototype software solutions for architectural concepts that may be months or years away from production silicon.
- Develop functional models, compiler prototypes, simulators, emulators, reference implementations or runtime abstractions as needed to validate architectural ideas.
- Demonstrate end-to-end execution of representative AI workloads on proposed NPU architectures.
- Build proof-of-concepts that allow hardware architects to make informed architectural decisions before RTL implementation.
- Help establish software models and interfaces that can later evolve into production compiler components.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Work closely with NPU hardware architects, micro-architects, RTL designers and the production compiler/software organization.
- Bridge the communication gap between hardware and software teams and translate requirements in both directions.
- Participate in architecture definition from early concept through implementation and silicon bring-up.
- Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction for compiler-driven hardware/software co-design.
- Influence the roadmap of future NPU architectures through workload and software-driven insights.

Necessary Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

8+ years of experience in compiler development, systems software, computer architecture, AI accelerators, or a closely related area.

Strong understanding of compiler architecture and compiler optimization techniques.

Strong C++ programming skills and proficiency in Python.

Strong understanding of computer architecture and familiarity with accelerator architectures, memory hierarchies and data movement.

Experience analyzing AI/ML workloads and understanding performance bottlenecks.

Ability to work across hardware and software boundaries and communicate effectively with hardware architects.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate architectural ideas.

Good to have

- Experience developing compilers or software stacks for NPUs, GPUs, DSPs, TPUs or other AI accelerators.
- Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TOSA, StableHLO, Torch-MLIR or similar compiler infrastructure.
- Experience with accelerator-specific scheduling, tiling, memory management or code generation.
- Understanding of NPU architecture concepts such as dataflow, tensor engines, systolic/array-based compute, local SRAMs, DMA/data movement and accelerator instruction sets.

postings.title: Principal Field Application Engineer - Automotive MCU
postings.description:
Role Summary

As an Automotive Field Application Engineer, you will provide comprehensive customer-facing technical support for Automotive MCU–based applications across multiple automotive domains. This role requires strong execution capability, system-level understanding, and the flexibility to support both key accounts and mass‑market customers.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to ensure smooth project execution, timely issue resolution, and effective adoption of Automotive MCU platforms across diverse applications such as BMS, Body/Zone Controllers, and Infotainment (Radio/Audio).

Responsibilities:

Customer Technical Support

- Provide on-site and remote technical support for Automotive MCU–based customer projects.

- Act as the primary technical interface for assigned customers during development, validation, and early production phases.

Application-Level Support

- Support AMCU-based applications including:

- Battery Management Systems (BMS)

- Body and Zone Controllers (AUTOSAR-based or non‑AUTOSAR)

- Radio, Audio, and selected Infotainment systems

- Assist customers with MCU bring-up, peripheral configuration, and system integration.

Debugging & Issue Resolution

- Analyze and resolve customer issues across hardware, software, and system levels.

- Support embedded software debugging, including drivers, RTOS integration, and AUTOSAR CP–based systems.

- Coordinate with internal AE, R&D, and product teams to ensure efficient issue escalation and closure.

Security & Safety Awareness Support

- Support customers in understanding and applying Automotive Cybersecurity concepts, including secure boot, secure communication, and basic key management usage.

- Assist customers in debugging security-related integration issues on MCU-based platforms.

- Demonstrate awareness of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) concepts and their impact on system usage and software integration.

Project & Account Support

- Support both key accounts with high engagement demands and mass‑market customers with parallel project requirements.

- Participate in customer design reviews, technical discussions, and on-site debug sessions.

- Maintain structured follow-up, documentation, and communication for customer issues and project status.

Customer Enablement & NPI Support

- Support customer adoption of reference designs, demos, and recommended usage models.

- Deliver technical workshops and hands-on guidance to customer engineering teams.

- Support customers during NPI phases from an application and usage perspective.

- Collect customer feedback and relay it effectively to internal teams.

Requirements:

Experience & Background

- 4–8 years of experience in automotive electronics, embedded systems, or customer-facing technical roles (FAE, Application Engineer, Technical Support).

- Practical experience supporting customer projects rather than pure R&D ownership.

Technical Skills

Automotive MCU

- Solid experience with Automotive MCU platforms (AMCU).

- Familiarity with MCU peripherals such as ADC, timers, PWM, communication interfaces, DMA, and basic system resources.

Embedded Software

- Experience working with embedded software stacks, BSPs, and peripheral drivers.

- Familiarity with AUTOSAR Classic (CP) concepts and integration is a strong plus.

- Comfortable using embedded debugging tools (JTAG, trace, logging, memory analysis).

Automotive Application Knowledge

- Practical understanding of one or more of the following domains:

- BMS or battery-related ECUs

- Body / Zone Controller architectures

- Radio / Audio / Infotainment systems

- System-level understanding of ECUs, including HW/SW interaction and integration constraints.

Security & Safety Awareness

- Basic understanding of Automotive Cybersecurity concepts, such as:

- Secure boot and firmware authentication

- Secure communication principles

- Key and certificate usage at system level

- Awareness of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) requirements and their influence on system design and software usage.

- Deep security or safety concept design experience is not required.

Soft Skills & Working Style

- Strong customer-oriented mindset with effective communication skills.

- Ability to handle multiple customer issues and projects in parallel.

- Comfortable working independently at customer sites when required.

- Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.

- English proficiency for daily technical communication (meetings, emails, documentation).

Preferred Qualifications (Plus):

- Experience supporting automotive OEMs or Tier‑1 customers.

- Exposure to Automotive Ethernet switches or time-sensitive networking concepts.

- Experience with system validation or field issue troubleshooting.

postings.description:
Job Title: Principal Global Sales Strategy Analyst – IIoT

Role Summary

NXP is hiring a Principal Sales Strategy Analyst on the Industrial / IIoT side of the business. Reporting to the Chief of Staff for the CSO, this role acts as an internal consultant to the CSO’s office — framing strategic questions, synthesizing markets, and translating technical complexity into decision-grade insight for senior commercial leadership across robotics, factory automation, AI, energy, and building automation.

This is a seat built for sharp early-career talent who combine a technical foundation with strategic rigor and want to take meaningful ownership inside a global commercial organization. It is a development platform, not a coordination role.

What You’ll Do

- Frame ambiguous strategic questions, build hypothesis-driven analyses, and deliver clear recommendations to the CSO and senior commercial leadership.

- Synthesize competitive dynamics, technology shifts, and customer trends into briefing materials that inform executive decisions.

- Engage senior leaders across product, marketing, and regional sales as a strategic thought partner, driving alignment on critical commercial questions.

- Own ad-hoc strategy projects end-to-end, from question to recommendation to follow-through.

Who You Are

- Curious by default. You investigate the “why” behind market shifts and aren’t satisfied with the conventional answer.

- Analytically rigorous. You think in hypotheses and frameworks, and you build a credible point of view from incomplete data.

- Commercially grounded. You can translate technology into customer and business value, and you communicate clearly and persuasively with executives.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Physics from a leading institution.

- MBA from a top-tier program, or equivalent experience.

- 3+ years of experience in management consulting at a top-tier firm (technology, industrial, or operations practice) — or directly relevant strategy/commercial experience in the semiconductor, software, or systems industries.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills for executive audiences.

The base salary range for this position is as mentioned below per year. We also provide competitive benefits, incentive compensation, and/or equity for certain roles.
Company benefits include health. dental, and vision insurance. 401(k), and paid leave. Please note that the base salary range (OR hourly rate) is a guideline, and individual total compensation may vary based on a number of factors such as qualifications, skill level, work location, and other business and organizational needs. This base pay range is specific to California and is not applicable to other locations. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range as of the date of this posting is:
$160,500 to $220,700 annually

postings.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Principal Hardware ASIC Architect Engineer

Hyderabad, India

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Hardware Architect with strong expertise in SOC-architecture, Micro-architecture design, RTL coding and system-level performance/power analysis.
The ideal candidate will have a track record of owning complex blocks or subsystems from concept through silicon, balancing performance, power, and area (PPA), and working closely with software, asic-design, asic-verification, asic-physicaldesign teams. it requires deep architectural insight and hands-on implementation understanding to help guide design trade-offs and drive the next generation of AI inference accelerators.

This is what you are responsible for

Architecture & Micro-Architecture

- Define product feature and capabilities and own the architecture for compute, memory, interconnect & high-speed interface subsystems in the AI inference chip.
- Collaborate with various software teams to co-optimize hardware features for AI workloads.
- Collaborate with RTL designers to identify complex technical issues/risks. Review and guide RTL implementation, ensuring consistency with architectural intent and timing/power goals
- Collaborate with Physical-design teams for Area/Floorplan refinement, Timing targets etc.
- Define and document interface specifications, control/status logic, and pipeline structures.

- Lead PPA analysis and trade-off discussions across RTL and architecture.

AI Workloads & HW-SW Co-Design

- Collaborate closely with various software to co-optimize hardware features for real-world AI inference workloads.
- Incorporate considerations such as, quantization, sparsity, dataflow, scheduling, memory bandwidth into architectural decisions.
- Guide hardware features that improve programmability, debuggability, and long-term software scalability.

Modelling & Analysis

- Develop and maintain high-level architecture and performance models.
- Use simulation and architectural models to guide RTL-level improvements.
- Validate model predictions against RTL or emulation results and refine accordingly.
- Strong understanding of AI inference workloads, dataflows, quantization, and memory/bandwidth bottlenecks in edge deployments

Necessary Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
- 12+ years of experience in SOC design, SOC architecture, RTL design, micro-architecture.

- Strong understanding of computer architecture, memory hierarchies, SoC interconnects, and AI/ML compute architectures.
- Proven experience optimizing for performance, power, and area.
- Hands-on expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog, C/C++, and scripting (Python/Tcl/Perl)

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience with AI accelerators, DSPs, or high-performance CPUs/GPUs.
- Familiarity with performance modeling frameworks (e.g., Python/C++ based).
- Exposure to EDA tools, power/performance analysis, and hardware-software co-design.
- Strong analytical skills and a collaborative mindset.

postings.title: Principal Hardware DFT Lead
postings.legal_entity: IN62 NXP India Pvt. Ltd. - Noida
postings.description:
We are looking for a Principal HW DFT Engineer who will architect, implement, and validate NXP’s Automotive grade products. You will be responsible for advanced test strategies and implementation, verification and validation of pre/post tapeout of DFT features, overall test coverage improvements, and work closely with RTL and physical team on DFT timing constraints and closures.

Main Job Tasks and Responsibilities:

- Architecture & Strategy: Define and implement advanced DFT strategies, including Scan Architecture, JTAG, Memory BIST (MBIST), and Logic BIST (LBIST)
- Implementation & Verification: Lead the integration of digital subsystems, perform scan insertion, and generate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns while ensuring high fault coverage.
- Silicon Support: Drive post-silicon validation and debug activities to root cause failures and improve manufacturing test efficiency.
- Collaboration: Coordinate with physical design and test engineering teams to ensure timing closure and that test patterns are operational immediately upon silicon arrival.

Minimum Required Qualifications

- Education: B.S./M.S. Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degrees)
- Experience: Typically requires 10+ years of industry experience in SoC DFT implementation, verification, static timing closure, test coverage analysis and improvement, and silicon bring-up on ATE
- Tool Expertise: Proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools from Mentor Graphics/Siemens (Tessent), Cadence, or Synopsys
- Technical Skills:
- DFT - Scan insertion and architecture, ATPG: Proficiency in generating test vectors to detect manufacturing faults like stuck-at, transition, and advanced faults, Built-In Self-Test (BIST): Integration of Memory BIST (MBIST) for embedded SRAM/ROM and Logic BIST (LBIST) for autonomous logic testing, Boundary Scan & JTAG, Test Compression: Implementing techniques to reduce test data volume and application time, which is critical for large System-on-Chip (SoC) designs.
- Hardware Design & Implementation - HDL Proficiency: Strong command of Verilog or SystemVerilog for modifying RTL to insert test logic and writing test wrappers. Timing & Constraints: Knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) and creating DFT-specific timing constraints (SDC files) to ensure test logic does not degrade functional performance.
- Verification & Debug - Simulation: Conducting gate-level simulations (GLS) and verifying DFT logic for correctness before fabrication. Post-Silicon Debug: Analyzing silicon data from Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to diagnose failures and improve manufacturing yield.
- Software & Tool Proficiency - EDA Tool Suites: Mastery of industry-standard tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Mentor Graphics Tessent, and Cadence Modus. Scripting & Automation: Expertise in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate test insertion flows, run simulations, and parse coverage reports.

postings.legal_entity: IT61 NXP Semiconductors Netherlands B.V. Branch Office Italia
postings.description:
NXP’s Industrial & IoT Edge solutions range from the smallest MCUs to very high-performance processors to provide real-time insights and efficient automation when performance matters most. NXP’s advanced portfolio of edge processing solutions lets developers explore their most innovative ideas with confidence, enabling applications across the autonomous home, industrial automation, and personal electronics.

NXP is building new teams in Catania to create high impact micro-controllers (MCU) as part of NXP’s intelligent AI at the Edge. This team will include a wide range of engineering talent from analog to SOC digital design. Full product development local will product world class products at a world class pace.

This role is a technical leader that bridges between HW and SW to ensure world-class solutions for our customers. The selected candidate will be a bridge to central SW team and will reside and work alongside the HW team to reuse and develop low level drivers. Responsible for ensuring high quality drivers to take full advantage of HW features and make them available via the SDK to customers (internal and external). He will drive HW-SW to ensure consistency, early verification of drivers and ROM features in simulation and in emulation before silicon tape out. The role will also ensure that product verification (SW + HW teams) and all validation teams are enabled with the same drivers for validation of the product.

Your Responsibilities.

- Technical lead for given SOC products in developing low‑level IP firmware (device drivers) for MCU platforms, ensuring high quality and reusability. Work closely with central SW teams to maximize reuse, consistency and ensure HW compatibility.

- Define and drive software architecture methodologies, standards, and best practices that enable consistent and reusable low‑level APIs across programs.

- Architect and deliver comprehensive IP firmware/driver solutions that support all phases of the lifecycle—RTL verification, virtual simulation, SoC verification, post‑silicon validation, and SDK integration

- Partner with pre‑silicon and post‑silicon teams to align HAL/SDK development with IP interface requirements and features.

- Work closely with HW, SW architects and SOC designers to initiate firmware development in parallel with hardware development.

- Review hardware register definitions and documentation early and regularly to remove disconnects and provide actionable feedback to improve software usability and long‑term maintainability. This role owns any gap closure.

- Establish and maintain backward‑compatible software interfaces as hardware IP evolves across products. Ensure linkage with HW IP and central SW team.

- Create architectural frameworks that promote consistency and scalability of driver implementations.

- Define best practices for delivering enablement drivers alongside hardware IP, ensuring smooth integration into SoC platforms and customer SDKs.

- Support multiple execution environments—simulation, emulation, and silicon—to ensure robust API behavior.

- Champion quality practices including design reviews, code reviews, static analysis, and adherence to coding standards.

- Produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation, reports, and presentations for stakeholders and milestone reviews.

- Use Git, JIRA, and Confluence to drive project execution, collaboration, and traceability.

- Mentor and guide junior and mid‑level software engineers, providing technical leadership and fostering a collaborative team environment.

- Contribute to ongoing optimization of firmware development workflows, tools, and cross‑team processes.

Your Profile.

- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience in RTL simulation and emulation. Must be able to understand how SOC’s are built and be able to work with RTL, HW and SW verification environments.

- 10+ years of experience in architecture and/or firmware development for MCUs/MPUs.

- Deep expertise in MCU/MPU SW architecture and low‑level firmware development, including RTL bring‑up, driver design, and platform‑level integration.

- Ability to lead by influence and bring cross‑functional teams together to accomplish goals.

- Experience leveraging AI capabilities to accelerate software development and documentation.

- Proficiency with ARM processor subsystems, tools, and debugging methodologies.

- Experience working with embedded RTOS and compilers.

- Competence in low‑level software testing and debugging for MCUs and MPUs.

- Ability to work in a multi‑site, multi‑time‑zone environment.

- Proficiency in C/C++/Assembly languages and at least one scripting language.

- Excellent problem‑solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross‑functional teams and mentor junior engineers.

- Prior experience in a technical leadership role, driving projects and influencing technical direction is highly desirable.

- Design and implement security features in Linux kernel features (e.g., device drivers, filesystems, networking stack, security modules).
- Build and optimize user‑space middleware (e.g., IPC frameworks, OpenSSL, DPDK) leveraging Userspace drivers.
- Implement and integrate security protocols (e.g., TLS 1.3, DTLS, IPsec, SSH,) and hardware-backed key management.
- Drive threat modeling, secure design reviews, and code audits, ensuring compliance with best practices (e.g., ASLR, stack canaries, SELinux/AppArmor policies).
- Lead performance and reliability engineering including profiling, tracing (ftrace, eBPF, perf), memory safety, and resource efficiency.
- Define platform CI/CD for low-level software (artifact signing, SBOMs, reproducible builds, Yocto/Buildroot/DEB/RPM pipelines).
- Mentor and grow engineers, guide technical roadmaps, and make pragmatic build/buy/OSS leverage decisions.
- Collaborate with Design team, IP team, DevOps, product, and QA to meet functional, performance, and certification goals.

Qualifications (Required)

- 10+ years of professional experience in systems/embedded/platform engineering, including technical leadership at team or org scale.
- Expert in C/C++ for systems-level development; nice to have proficiency in Rust for memory‑safe components.
- Demonstrated depth in Linux kernel internals (at least two areas): drivers, MM, scheduler, net, filesystems, security modules (LSMs), eBPF.
- Hands-on boot loader development and customization (U‑Boot, GRUB, secure boot flows, measured boot, boot-time diagnostics).
- Strong knowledge of security protocols and cryptography (TLS/IPsec, X.509/PKI, key exchange, HSM/TPM, secure storage, attestation).
- Experience building user‑space middleware (IPC, service management with systemd, observability/logging, configuration frameworks).

- Virtualization & containers: KVM/QEMU, Kata Containers, cgroups, namespaces; container security (seccomp, SELinux/AppArmor).
- Networking & storage: DPDK, SR-IOV, NVMe, RDMA, io_uring; high‑throughput low‑latency pipeline design.
- Safety/security certifications: FIPS 140‑3 validation, Common Criteria, ISO 27001/21434, AUTOSAR, IEC 62443.

- Scripting/automation: Python, Bash; Bazel/CMake/Meson; advanced CI (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Buildkite).

postings.title: Principal Software Engineer - Compilers
postings.description:
Who We Are

This role is part of the Kinara Group at NXP Semiconductors, combining the agility and innovation of a startup with the scale, stability, and global reach of a leading semiconductor company.

Kinara was founded on patented technology developed during the founders’ Ph.D. research at Stanford University, with a mission to redefine AI inference at the edge through tightly integrated hardware and software. Following Kinara’s acquisition, this mission continues within NXP, with the Kinara team operating as a dedicated AI accelerator and software group focused on pushing the boundaries of edge AI.

The team has delivered two generations of AI silicon shipping in volume, supported by a mature and production‑ready software stack, making it one of the most proven edge AI platforms in the industry. Kinara technology is used by marquee customers, including GAFA‑class companies, a leading global e‑commerce provider, and Tier‑1 PC OEMs.

As part of NXP, the Kinara Group now benefits from world‑class silicon execution, manufacturing scale, and customer access, while retaining its startup culture, deep AI expertise, and compiler‑driven engineering mindset. Joining this team offers the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI compiler and silicon technology, with real‑world impact and long‑term stability.

What We Do

We build game‑changing edge AI solutions that enable faster, smarter, and more power‑efficient decision making where every millisecond matters.

At the core of our platform are Ara AI inference processors, purpose‑built to deliver unrivaled deep learning performance per watt at the edge. Paired with our comprehensive SDK and software toolchain, these processors enable developers to deploy and optimize complex AI models for real‑time inference under tight latency and power constraints.

Kinara’s hardware–software co‑design approach allows high‑performance AI to be seamlessly embedded into edge devices, enabling applications across vision, industrial automation, consumer electronics, and intelligent systems. Our solutions focus on performance, efficiency, and scalability, helping customers bring advanced AI capabilities out of the cloud and into the real world.

Edge AI is at an inflection point, and the Kinara Group within NXP is uniquely positioned to play a leading role in its growth, delivering production‑proven silicon, a robust compiler and SDK stack, and a clear roadmap for next‑generation intelligent edge devices.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Front-End Compiler Engineer with 10+ years of experience to lead the design and development of our AI/ML compiler front-end. The role focuses on building scalable model conversion pipelines that translate models from ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch into our internal Intermediate Representation (IR).

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in compiler design, graph-based optimizations, machine learning frameworks, and modern AI architectures including Transformers and Large Language Models (LLMs). You will collaborate with compiler backend, runtime, performance, and hardware teams to deliver a high-performance and production-ready AI compiler stack.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop compiler front-end architecture and model conversion frameworks.
- Build and maintain Python-based converters for ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
- Implement graph construction, graph transformation, IR lowering, and optimization pipelines.
- Develop graph optimization passes including operator fusion, canonicalization, simplification, and decomposition.
- Design scalable pattern-matching and graph-rewrite frameworks.
- Enable support for modern AI architectures such as CNNs, Transformers, and LLMs.
- Drive validation, testing infrastructure, regression testing, and CI/CD integration.
- Debug and resolve issues across model conversion, optimization, and IR generation stages.
- Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams.

Required Skills & Experience

- 10+ years of experience in compiler development, ML systems, or AI infrastructure.
- Strong Python programming and software architecture skills.
- Deep understanding of:
- Intermediate Representations (IRs)
- Graph-based computation models
- Compiler transformations and optimizations
- Pattern matching and graph rewriting

- Hands-on experience with ONNX, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
- Experience in graph parsing, graph transformations, and ML model optimizations.
- Strong understanding of CNNs, Transformers, and LLM architectures.
- Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and technical leadership skills.

Good to Have

- Experience with MLIR, TOSA, StableHLO, or Torch-MLIR.
- Familiarity with AI compiler stacks such as IREE, TVM, XLA, TensorRT, or ONNX Runtime.
- Experience targeting GPUs, NPUs, DSPs, or custom AI accelerators.
- Knowledge of quantization, model optimization, and deployment workflows.

As a member of NXP's Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will play a key role in safeguarding our secure chip products after they have been deployed to customers around the globe.

postings.title: PSE Technician
postings.description:
Locatie: Nijmegen
Werkomgeving: On-site
Opleidingsniveau: MBO WEB 3/4 of VAPRO B/C (of bereid om dat binnen gestelde termijn te halen)
Functieniveau: Functiegroep B3-B4
Ervaring: +/-3 jaar aantoonbare relevante werkervaring binnen semiconductor industrie

Ben jij leergierig en zou je graag werkzaam willen zijn in een high tech omgeving?

De ICN8 fabriek in Nijmegen is voor NXP Semiconductors een belangrijke en tevens de grootste chipfabriek van Europa. De druk om de beste in de semiconductor-industrie te zijn en te blijven is zeer groot. Onze kracht ligt vooral in veelzijdigheid, gecombineerd met hoge kwaliteitseisen van de automotive industrie en mobiele telefoon business.

NXP produceert tientallen miljarden chips per jaar en ICN8 draagt daar voor ongeveer een kwart aan bij. Dit betekent dat wij hier in Nijmegen meetellen voor meer dan 2 chips per wereldburger per jaar!

Wij geloven in de kracht van samenwerken, als basis van onze activiteiten. Daarom investeren we permanent in onze medewerkers en in de relatie met onze klanten, waar ook ter wereld. Nieuwsgierig naar onze organisatie? Check deze video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VoSEhM3lNMM

Voor ICN8 zijn we op zoek naar Technicians.

ICN8 is verantwoordelijk voor de fabricage van diffusie wafers die later extern afgemonteerd worden tot geïntegreerde schakelingen. Process Sustaining & Enhancement (PSE) is onderdeel van de ICN8 organisatie en heeft als taak bestaande processen te beheersen en verbeteren en de technische kwaliteit te bewaken van de aan de klant te leveren producten. Daarnaast is de afdeling verantwoordelijk voor het introduceren van nieuwe processen. Vanwege de introductie van een nieuw process en de toenemende fab belading zijn wij op zoek naar een extra PSE technician.

De PSE technician werkt in een 3 ploegendienst en staat opgesteld voor beoordeling en afhandeling van PCM (elektrische) uitgangscontrole van product wafers en voor defectivity inline metingen.

Het werkgebied strekt zich uit over de hele fabriek (en beperkt zich dus niet tot een area). Buiten dagdiensturen is de PSE-technician de enige aangewezen persoon van de gehele PSE sectie en is hierbij het aanspreek punt voor alle mogelijke product gerelateerde kwaliteitsissues.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

• De PSE-technician handelt alle proces integratie en defectivity gerelateerde zaken af. Zoals hold lots, out of controls, out of specs, beoordeling van procesproblemen, kwaliteitsbewaking van het productieproces en de wafers ten behoeve van beheerste productie en kwalitatief goede wafers.

• De PSE Technician signaleert incidenten en probleemsituaties met apparatuur of met processen die de kwaliteit van lots aantast of zou kunnen aantasten. Hij reageert hiervoor op meldingen uit de ploeg, scant kritisch de Defectivity en Proces Integratie hold-lot lijsten en let op mogelijk aanwezige risico’s tijdens het afhandelen van hold lots en neemt direct actie bij afwijkingen.

Functie-eisen:

- MBO techniek (bij voorkeur Procestechniek of Elektronica) op WEB 3/4 niveau of VAPRO niveau B/C (of bereid om dat binnen gestelde termijn te halen)
- Ervaren operators met plustaken en operators techniek worden van harte uitgenodigd om te solliciteren, je wordt opgeleid tot een volwaardig PSE technician
- Kennis van equipment- en proces technische aspecten van de semiconductor industrie, kennis van PCM test modules, meetmethoden en parameter nomenclatuur, procesflows van alle vrijgegeven productieprocessen, en proceskennis van de basisstappen in deze procesflows.
- 3 Jaar aantoonbare relevante werkervaring binnen semiconductor industrie
- Gedisciplineerde werkhouding
- Precies, aandacht voor kwaliteit
- Kunnen omgaan met veranderingen
- Kunnen functioneren onder hoge werkdruk
- Zelfstandig kunnen werken
- Resultaatgerichte instelling
- Groot analytisch en rationeel denkvermogen
- Beschikken over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
- Flexibiliteit m.b.t. beschikbaarheid buiten eigen dienstrooster
- Basiskennis Engelse taal
- Leergierig, bereidheid tot het volgen van trainingen

Indien je net zo enthousiast bent als dat wij zijn over deze vacature, dan nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nadat we je CV gescreend hebben, en afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring, zullen we je uitnodigen voor selectie gesprekken.

postings.description:
Ready to join the future of innovation in IT at NXP?

Do you love to collaborate with the business to translate their strategy into solid IT solutions?

Do you have the experience to be a sparring partner for both IT and Business colleagues?

Do you thrive in a role with a lot of room for your own ideas and innovation?

Do you want to make an impact on both our business and our customers?

Do you get excited by the prospect to be part of an international diverse company?

Then we are looking for you in the role of Sales IT System Architect.

The System Architect is the glue between Sales and IT. You will be responsible for understanding the needs of the Sales organization on a strategic and operational level and translating those into sound solutions. Tasks will include business requirement gathering, architecting, designing and -in some instances- implementing solutions. You will be working in an Agile and DevOps way, together in a supporting environment, with continuous focus on development and coaching.

Your responsibilities

- Work together with the Sales team to understand and analyze their requirements, and propose (IT) solution directions, in line with the NXP enterprise architecture
- Team up with internal and external resources to implement solutions and provide architectural oversight
- Collaborate with other architects within the company to deliver end-to-end solutions that are transformational leveraging AI/ML
- Help define the architectural roadmap and strategy for the team to create future-proof solutions
- Create and maintain architectural documents for applications within the team’s portfolio
- Build PoCs when needed and apply code when required

Your team

NXP IT is well recognized as a modern IT organization with a DevOps way of working. We are a diversified team with high energy, an open collaboration environment and eagerness for continuous improvement.

Within Sales and Marketing IT we focus on internal and external applications to support the Customer journey. We collaborate with our business teams daily on strategic improvements and with vendor partners to deliver easy-to-use applications leveraging SaaS, cloud services and custom development where needed.

To be successful in this role you have

- BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent years of relevant experience
- 5+ years’ experience in Information Technology (Consultancy, Project or Development) in the Sales and Marketing domain
- Deep core competence in applying IT strategically to fundamentally change an enterprise and enable a company to achieve its strategic, tactical and operational goals
- Knowledge and experience in the following areas:
- Required: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Agentforce, DataCloud, AI/ML
- Preferred: Eloqua, Xactly, Gen AI
- Functional areas like: Customer Relation Management, Product Support, Customer Support, Sales Incentive Planning, (Customer) Master Data management, Lead Management

- Experience using Agile methodologies and familiar with tools for Agile project management and software development
- You have an advantage if you also bring:
- Knowledge of, or experience with development languages, tools, technologies and frameworks used to deliver state of the art, secure solutions for Sales and Marketing
- Experience with Continuous Integration tools and processes
- Knowledge of how to leverage Business Intelligence/Analytics

Furthermore, you are

- able to collaborate and partner with business and IT in defining, preparing and executing projects and change programs
- able to get your point across to your juniors, peers and management in IT as well as business
- an excellent communicator with good presentation skills and the ability to work with a geographically dispersed, multi-cultural team

postings.legal_entity: AT61 NXP Semiconductors Austria GmbH & Co KG
postings.description:
Shape the Future of Trusted Security at NXP

As a Secure Software Architect TPM you will be joining a team that is developing next-generation embedded software products for a wide range of security applications.

This is an opportunity for an experienced software architect and technical leader to define and drive the architecture and implementation of a Trusted Platform Module solution. You will be able to shape security architectures and bridge customer needs, industry standards, and cutting-edge technology to create highly secure, scalable, and certifiable software solutions used worldwide.

Your Responsibilities:

- Translate customer requirements and use cases, standards, and system constraints into clear software architecture designs and implementation concepts.

- Ensure compliance with applicable standards, including TPM 2.0, Trusted Computing Group specifications, and relevant security certification requirements.

- Design and develop secure embedded software for Trusted Platform Module applications, with a strong focus on quality, robustness, and long-term maintainability.

- Provide technical guidance to development teams, including architecture decisions, design reviews, and code reviews.

- Monitor software quality, relevant KPIs, and development progress, and drive actions to achieve agreed targets.

- Collaborate closely with system, SOC, and test architects throughout the concept phase and project execution to ensure technical alignment.

Your Profile:

- Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a comparable field.

- At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in embedded software development, software architecture, or secure product development.

- Hands-on experience in embedded software development and working with complex software stacks and secure software update mechanisms.

- Knowledge of Trusted Platform Module and TPM Software Stack specifications is desirable.

- Experience with Java Card operating systems or similar secure execution environments is an advantage.

- Experience with Common Criteria, AVA_VAN attack-resistance evaluation, FIPS 140, TCG certification, or comparable security certification schemes is an advantage.

- Familiarity with ARM, RISC-V or other processor architectures is an advantage.

- Good understanding of cryptographic algorithms, secure key and certificate handling, secure boot, attestation, and secure software design principles.

- Proven ability to technically lead, guide, and align multi-site software development teams.

- Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

At NXP, your ideas will help secure the technologies shaping tomorrow, from smart devices to industrial systems and beyond. You will work with world-class experts, influence strategic architecture decisions, and contribute to solutions deployed across global markets.

Please note: The successful candidate may/will be responsible for security related tasks. The assignment may/will be in scope of security certifications, therefore a conscious and reliable way of working is necessary.

NXP provides market competitive compensation according to the benchmarking of the electronic and semiconductor industry. Due to the Austrian Equal Treatment Act we are obligated to state the employment group of our applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) “Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte Gewerbe und Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung“, this position (fulltime) is graded in Employment Group VI. Your individual experiences and expectations will be considered in the application process. Moreover, we provide attractive benefits to our employees like home office, flexible working time, meal benefits and more.

Join NXP as a Senior AMS Verification leader

At NXP, we create technologies that make the connected world better, safer, and more secure. Within the Advanced Power System team, we are looking for a Senior AMS Verification Engineer to lead mixed-signal verification activities for advanced automotive and industrial products. You will define verification strategies, improve methodologies, collaborate with global expert teams, and help deliver robust silicon with a strong Total Quality mindset.

What you will do

In this role, you will contribute to complex NXP projects from specification review to silicon correlation, with ownership of key AMS verification deliverables.

- Lead AMS verification activities and guide engineers toward successful project delivery.
- Define verification plans, strategies, environments, regressions, and coverage objectives.
- Develop and validate mixed-signal simulation environments, behavioural models, checkers, assertions, and reusable verification components.
- Bridge digital verification and mixed-signal verification flows for robust top-level verification.
- Drive methodology improvements to increase simulation efficiency, reuse, quality, and cost effectiveness.
- Support design reviews, bug tracking, post-silicon correlation, and continuous improvement across projects.

What you will bring

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field.
- 10+ years of experience in AMS or mixed-signal IC verification.
- Strong experience leading verification activities for complex ASIC or mixed-signal IC projects.
- Solid knowledge of analog fundamentals, digital RTL debug, co-simulation, and mixed-signal verification methodologies.
- Hands-on experience with verification plans, testbenches, regressions, coverage, reviews, and bug closure.
- Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, UVM, SVA, Verilog-AMS, SystemC, WREAL/RNM modelling, and EDA tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Xcelium, Spectre, and vManager.
- Good scripting skills in Python, Perl, or TCL, and experience with Git, SVN, or DesignSync.

Nice to have

- Experience with automotive, industrial, safety-oriented, power management, or power application products.

How you will thrive at NXP

- Analytical mindset, strong ownership, and structured problem-solving skills.
- Clear communication and collaboration skills in international, multidisciplinary teams.
- Commitment to Total Quality, continuous improvement, and customer-focused delivery.

Why join NXP?

NXP is a global semiconductor leader enabling a smarter, safer, and more connected world. You will join a diverse and inclusive environment that values innovation, learning, collaboration, and individual growth, while contributing directly to advanced mixed-signal products and silicon quality.

If you enjoy solving complex verification challenges and working with bright minds to make a real impact, we would be pleased to hear from you. Together, we are NXP.

Job Position: Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

Role Summary

The Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst serves as a senior member of the Cyber Threat Intelligence program and is responsible for independently collecting, analyzing, enriching, and disseminating actionable intelligence on emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, and evolving attack trends. This role transforms complex technical and strategic threat information into actionable insights that support security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, and enterprise risk decisions.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in cyber threat intelligence tradecraft, threat actor tracking, infrastructure analysis, and intelligence production. They operate with minimal supervision, lead complex intelligence investigations, provide authoritative threat assessments, and serve as a trusted advisor to technical teams and leadership. Success requires strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, technical curiosity, and the ability to communicate intelligence effectively across a broad range of stakeholders.

Your Opportunity

NXP is a global player in Semiconductor industry, and security is an essential and integral part of our business.

Job Responsibility

- Monitor and assess emerging cyber threats, adversary activity, malware campaigns, and vulnerability exploitation trends.
- Track threat actors and analyze their capabilities, targeting, infrastructure, and tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
- Conduct technical investigations using threat intelligence, open-source intelligence (OSINT), and infrastructure analysis techniques.
- Correlate intelligence from multiple sources and assess potential impact to the organization.
- Lead indicator of compromise (IOC) collection, enrichment, validation, and lifecycle management activities.
- Maintain intelligence records, indicators, and threat artifacts within the organization’s Threat Intelligence Platform (TIP).
- Develop and disseminate actionable threat advisories, intelligence reports, and emerging threat notifications.
- Support intelligence-sharing efforts with internal stakeholders and trusted external partners.
- Produce tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and business audiences.
- Deliver intelligence briefings to security teams, leadership, and other stakeholders.
- Provide threat-informed recommendations that improve organizational awareness and preparedness.
- Serve as a subject matter expert on adversary activity, emerging threats, and cyber risk trends.
- Provide intelligence support during cybersecurity investigations and incident response activities.
- Perform adversary-focused analysis to support incident scoping, attribution, and impact assessments.
- Partner with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, and Risk teams to provide threat context and intelligence insights.
- Identify intelligence gaps, emerging risks, and opportunities to strengthen defensive capabilities.

Job Qualification

Professional Experience

- 10+ years of experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence, Threat Research, Incident Response, Security Operations, or related cybersecurity disciplines.
- Demonstrated experience tracking threat actors, malware campaigns, adversary infrastructure, and emerging cyber threats.
- Experience producing tactical, operational, and strategic intelligence products for technical and executive audiences.
- Proven ability to independently conduct investigations, develop actionable intelligence, and brief stakeholders.
- Familiarity with nation-state actors, sophisticated cybercriminal groups, and supply chain threats.
- Experience in intelligence-driven hunting to identify suspicious network activity and potential risks.

Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of threat intelligence tradecraft, intelligence lifecycle methodologies, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
- Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies including MITRE ATT&CK, ATT&CK Navigator, Diamond Model, Cyber Kill Chain, STIX/TAXII, Intelligence Lifecycle, and Structured Analytic Techniques.
- Experience with Threat Intelligence Platforms such as Anomali, ThreatQ, ThreatConnect, OpenCTI, MISP, or similar platforms.
- Proficiency with intelligence and OSINT tools such as Maltego, VirusTotal, Shodan, Censys, DomainTools, PassiveTotal, GreyNoise, URLScan, SecurityTrails, or similar investigative platforms.
- Knowledge of threat actor clustering methodologies used to track adversary campaigns, intrusion sets, and threat group activity.

* Proficiency with industry-standard synthesis tools (e.g., Synopsys Design Compiler, Synopsys Fusion Compiler or similar).

postings.title: Senior Digital/AMS Validation and Integration Engineer
postings.description:
We are seeking a Senior Digital/AMS Design Engineer to drive the integration of complex digital logic into our industry-leading Automotive SerDes transceivers. In this role, you will be responsible for the RTL design of the "Digital-Analog Wrapper," ensuring seamless control and data flow between high-speed analog front-ends and the DSP/Link-layer logic. You will own the path from RTL through timing closure and support the validation of that logic in the lab.

Key Responsibilities

- RTL Design & Integration: Develop and integrate RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) for control loops, calibration engines, and high-speed data paths in 10G+ transceivers.

- Mixed-Signal Interface: Define and implement the digital interface for analog blocks (ADCs, PLLs, Driver stages), ensuring robust signal crossing between asynchronous domains.

- Timing Closure & Synthesis: Lead the digital implementation flow, working closely with the physical design team to achieve timing closure in high-speed clock domains.

- Silicon Validation: (40% Lab Focus) Partner with the validation team to bring up silicon. Use Python-based tools to exercise RTL features, debug state machines, and verify registers (CSRs) in real-time hardware.

- Functional Correctness: Execute block-level and chip-level simulations to ensure digital control logic correctly handles analog PVT variations and startup sequences.

Skills & Qualifications

- Education: BSEE/MSEE with 5–8+ years of experience in Digital RTL Design or Digital Integration.

- HDL Expertise: Advanced proficiency in SystemVerilog/Verilog for synthesis.

- Timing & Implementation: Strong understanding of Static Timing Analysis (STA), clock domain crossing (CDC), and constraints (SDC).

- Scripting & Automation: Deep experience with Python or Perl for hardware control, test automation, and data processing.

- Lab Skills: Proficient in using logic analyzers, high-speed scopes, and JTAG/I2C/SPI protocols for on-chip debugging.

Preferred Experience

- Experience with 10GBase-T, ASA, or Automotive Ethernet standards.

- Familiarity with the hand-off between digital logic and high-speed Analog Front Ends (AFE).

- Knowledge of DFT (Design for Test) and BIST (Built-In Self-Test) insertion for high-speed links.

- Able to create Verilog-A models

postings.title: Senior equipment engineer WET
postings.description:
Ben jij een techneut en op zoek naar een rol in een dynamische hightech werkomgeving? Haal jij je energie uit complexe troubleshooting en het werken aan hightech apparatuur? Kunt je omgaan met de eisen om het maximale uit je toolpark te halen? Ben je gestructureerd genoeg om de technische productieprocessen te overzien en te verbeteren? Ben jij analytisch ingesteld waardoor je onze prestaties verder kunt optimaliseren? Dan is dit misschien een kans voor jou.

NXP Semiconductors N.V. biedt “High Performance Mixed Signal” en “Standard Product solutions” die gebruik maken van toonaangevende technologieën. Onze producten worden gebruikt in een breed scala van toepassingen in de automobielindustrie, identificatie, draadloze infrastructuur, verlichting en mobiele-, consumenten- en computertoepassingen. NXP Semiconductors heeft activiteiten in meer dan 35 landen, meer dan 45.000 medewerkers en een omzet van meer dan $ 10 miljard.

ICN8 is de grootste 8-inch wafers fabriek in Europa. Het is een hightech omgeving met veel multidisciplinaire uitdagingen, met meer dan 450 productietools (ASML, ASM/TEL, Applied Material, LAM, ……) en 150 meetinstrumenten (inline inspecties, einde van inline testen).

De functionaris “Equipment Engineer” ondersteunt de Equipment and Process Engineering (EPE) organisatie door het onderhouden, initiëren en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en het bieden van ondersteuning aan de productieorganisatie.

De afdeling wet process wordt gekenmerkt als een technische organisatie met een sterke focus op verbeteringen. We zijn een divers team met veel energie, een open samenwerkingsomgeving en gretigheid voor continue verbeteren. Het team bestaat uit 8-12 engineers en is voornamelijk gericht op het ondersteunen van de productie en werkt actief aan verbetering van de productkwaliteit en toolcapaciteit.

Als Equipment Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor een toolpark waarbij je focust ligt bij de complexere problemen. Naast het analyseren en oplossen van problemen ontwikkel en introduceer je actief verbeteringen op het gebied van productkwaliteit, throughput, afvalreductie, kostenbesparingen en reductie van repeaters. Daarnaast ondersteun je (tezamen met EPE collega’s, technicians en operators) de productie zodat de ICN8 organisatie op excellente wijze kan performen. Als equipment engineer rapporteer je aan de Manager EPE IMPLANT/WET/TWM.

Verantwoordelijkheden:
• Verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden en continu verbeteren van jouw toolpark, welke voldoet aan de veiligheids- en kwaliteitseisen van NXP en aan de geldende normen en validatieverbeteringen op de werkvloer.
• Verbindt proactief met productie en draagt verbeterideeën aan met betrekking tot structurele technische problemen, kwaliteits gerelateerde zaken en bottleneck issues. Betrekt indien van toepassing andere secties en afdelingen en stuurt deze acties aan tot succesvolle implementatie.
• Gebruikt technische kennis en ervaring om bij te dragen aan verbeterprojecten.
• Definieert de benodigde toolcapaciteit en zorgt voor de juiste beschikbaarheid van productietools. Initieert upgrades, ondersteunt onderhoudsacties en lost veiligheidsproblemen op.
• Bewaakt pro actief de kwaliteit en analyseert/rapporteert incidenten welke gerelateerd zijn aan issues met jouw toolpark.

Jouw profiel
• Om succesvol te zijn in deze rol beschik je over een BSc. of MSc. niveau in autotechniek, elektronica, mechatronica, werktuigbouwkunde of een ander relevant technisch gebied.
• Kennis van complexe productieprocessen in een hightech omgeving (bij voorkeur)
• Kennis van Lean Manufacturing, procesoptimalisatie, statistische machinebesturing, FMEA en kwaliteitsmanagementsystemen (bij voorkeur)

Ervaring
• Vermogen tot het eigen maken van het complexe manufacturing process en de gebruikte technologieën
• Kennis van equipment- en proces technische aspecten van de semiconductor industrie
• Kennis van SPC, basiskennis statistische analyse
• Ervaren met Microsoft Office
• Analytisch en rationeel denkvermogen
• Continu vinden/ontwikkelen en implementeren van nieuwe methodieken die performance verbetering mogelijk maken

Persoonlijkheid
• Analytisch, pragmatisch, proactief en klantgericht
• Zelfverzekerd en in staat om mensen te boeien en te overtuigen, ook op hogere managementniveaus
• Neemt initiatief; toont eigenaarschap, heeft een “hands on” mentaliteit
• Samenwerken; Is een betrouwbare teamspeler, kan goed luisteren en neemt andere ideeën en meningen in zich op. Goede sociale/communicatieve vaardigheden op verschillende niveaus in de organisatie
• Leert snel, kan prioriteiten stellen en zelfstandig opereren en zich aanpassen aan veranderende omstandigheden gericht op kwaliteit en continue verbetering
• Stress bestendig
• Resultaat- en kwaliteitsgerichte instelling
• Beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden

Ons Young Professional-programma biedt verschillende mogelijkheden voor snelle ontwikkeling in technische en persoonlijke vaardigheden. ICN8 waferfab is een ideale omgeving om de 'echte wereld van productie' te leren kennen.

postings.title: Senior Exposure Threat Hunter
postings.description:
Job Title: Senior Exposure Threat Hunter

Location: Austin, USA

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Exposure Threat Hunter to join our Information Security team. This role is focused on proactively identifying, investigating, and validating security exposures, attack paths, and security weaknesses that could be leveraged by threat actors across the enterprise.

The ideal candidate will have a strong Information Security background with experience in Security Operations (SOC), Threat Hunting, Security Engineering, Detection Engineering, or Incident Response. They should understand attacker methodologies, common attack techniques, security tooling, and investigative processes, and be capable of identifying potential risks before they can be exploited.

This position requires a proactive security mindset, strong investigative skills, and the ability to bridge technical findings with actionable risk reduction strategies.

Job Responsibility

- Proactively identify, investigate, and validate security exposures, attack paths, misconfigurations, and control weaknesses across enterprise environments.
- Conduct threat hunting activities to uncover potential risks, attacker opportunities, and indicators of compromise that may not be detected through traditional monitoring.
- Analyze security telemetry, logs, identity-related data, cloud security findings, endpoint activity, and threat intelligence to identify security gaps and exploitable conditions.
- Assess exposures from an attacker’s perspective and determine potential exploitation scenarios and business impact.
- Leverage security tools and technologies to investigate findings and uncover relationships between assets, identities, privileges, and security controls.
- Collaborate with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Engineering, Cloud Security, and Incident Response teams to validate findings and support remediation efforts.
- Contribute to the development and improvement of exposure hunting methodologies, investigative procedures, and operational processes.
- Assist in the creation, tuning, and optimization of detection rules and monitoring capabilities that help identify attacker behaviors and high-risk exposures.
- Research emerging threats, attacker techniques, and industry trends to improve threat hunting and exposure management capabilities.
- Document findings, risk assessments, recommendations, and remediation guidance in a clear and actionable manner.
- Provide strategic recommendations to reduce organizational attack surface and improve overall security posture.
- Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in Information Security, preferably within one or more of the following areas:
- Security Operations Center (SOC)
- Threat Hunting
- Security Engineering
- Detection Engineering
- Incident Response

- Strong understanding of security operations processes, methodologies, and investigative workflows.
- Solid understanding of the cyber-attack lifecycle and common attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

- Experience working with enterprise security technologies such as:
- SIEM platforms
- EDR/XDR solutions
- Identity security tools
- Cloud security platforms
- Exposure management and attack surface management solutions

- Knowledge of common attack techniques, including:
- Initial access
- Credential abuse
- Privilege escalation
- Persistence
- Lateral movement
- Defense evasion
- Data access and exfiltration techniques

- Experience analyzing security logs, endpoint telemetry, authentication activity, network events, and cloud-native security data.
- Understanding security detections, alerting mechanisms, and investigative techniques.

- Familiarity with industry frameworks and methodologies such as:
- MITRE ATT&CK
- Cyber Kill Chain
- Threat Hunting methodologies
- Risk-based prioritization approaches

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working within large-scale enterprise Information Security environments.
- Experience with exposure management, attack path analysis, identity security, attack surface management, or adversary exposure validation programs.
- Strong knowledge of SIEM platforms and security event analysis, including the ability to investigate, correlate, and analyze security telemetry from multiple data sources to identify attacker activity, security weaknesses, and emerging threats.
- Understanding of cloud security concepts across Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud environments.
- Experience developing, tuning, or maintaining security detections and analytics.
- Familiarity with threat intelligence and its application within security investigations and threat hunting activities.
- Experience working with automation or orchestration capabilities within security operations environments.

Preferred Certifications

GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)

GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)

GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI)

GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA)

Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)

As a strategic partner at the intersection of customer ambition and NXP capability, our global sales team drives alignment, opens new markets, and builds the relationships that lead to design wins and revenue growth.

As part of the evolution of the European Microprocessors (MPUs) and Discrete Neural Processors Units (DNPUs) Field Application Engineering organization, we are looking for a senior FAE to support our solutions for key customers in EMEA with a focus on the robotics segment.

In this role, working closely with Sales and Key Account Managers, you will act as the primary technical interface to customer engineering teams, supporting system architects and developers in defining and deploying next-generation systems.

Responsibilities

- Provide technical leadership to sales teams and customers covering edge-compute architecture, processor selection, bring-up, and software stack integration for NXP MPU and DNPU processors targeting robotics platforms.

- Partner with customers on the design of companion computers, central compute, vision/perception subsystems, and HMI nodes — from silicon selection through Linux board bring-up, kernel/driver enablement, and system performance tuning.
- Enable customer AI, vision, and sensor-fusion workloads on NXP processors and integrated NPUs, helping customers move models from training frameworks to optimized on-device inference for perception, navigation, and HMI use cases.
- Deliver on-site and remote proof-of-concept builds using NXP evaluation kits, robotics reference designs, and BSP / SDK enablement, demonstrating end-to-end solutions for customers use cases.

Job Qualifications

- Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science
- 10+ years in embedded systems development or applications support of MPU / SoC-based platforms running embedded Linux, with demonstrated technical leadership.
- Strong embedded Linux experience across the full stack: bootloader (u-boot), kernel and device drivers, device tree, Yocto / build system, and user-space integration.
- Proficient in C/C++ for embedded development, plus working knowledge of Python or scripting for tooling and automation.
- Hands-on experience with ARM Cortex-A class application processors and heterogeneous compute architectures pairing application cores with real-time microcontroller cores.
- Working knowledge of high-speed application-processor interfaces and how to design around them: LPDDR, PCIe, USB 3.x, MIPI-CSI / MIPI-DSI, Gigabit / Multi-Gigabit Ethernet, SDIO / eMMC, and QSPI.
- Experience optimizing PCB design for high-speed application-processor interfaces (impedance control, length matching, EMC/EMI, and power integrity).
- Strong troubleshooting skills with schematic review, signal analysis, and lab tools.
- Excellent verbal and written communication for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Willingness to travel
- Fluent English required

Specialty and bonus skills

- Hands-on experience enabling AI / ML workloads on edge processors and integrated NPUs, including model conversion and optimization from common training frameworks to on-device inference for robotics perception.
- Working knowledge of computer-vision and sensor-fusion pipelines: MIPI-CSI camera bring-up, ISP tuning, multi-camera synchronization, and fusion of camera, LiDAR, radar, time-of-flight, and IMU inputs feeding perception and localization.
- Familiarity with robotics middleware and stacks: Rust, ROS / ROS 2, DDS, real-time Linux (PREEMPT_RT), and common SLAM, navigation, and motion-planning frameworks.
- Experience with heterogeneous compute and inter-core communication frameworks (e.g., RPMsg / OpenAMP) used to combine Linux with real-time control on a single SoC.
- Working knowledge of platform security: TrustZone, secure boot, OP-TEE, integrated secure enclaves, and secure-element integration for authenticated robotics endpoints.
- Familiarity with connectivity in robotics — Wi-Fi, Bluetooth / BLE, 802.15.4, UWB, NFC — and in-robot networking interfaces such as Gigabit / Multi-Gigabit Ethernet, TSN-capable interfaces, and Single-Pair Ethernet.
- Familiarity with power-management subsystems for application processors (PMIC integration, DVFS, multi-rail / thermal management) and battery-powered system architectures, including 48V platforms.
- Working knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262, IEC 61508 / SIL 2–3) and cybersecurity (ISO 21434, IEC 62443) standards relevant to industrial and automotive edge-compute systems.
